title.zh: 卷一百二十四 列傳第七十四: 薛嵩 令狐彰 田神功 侯希逸 李正己
title.en: Volume 124 Biographies 74: Xue Song, Ling Huzhuang, Tian Shengong, Hou Xiyi, Li Zhengji
title.raw: 卷一百二十四 列傳第七十四: 薛嵩 令狐彰 田神功 侯希逸 李正己 Volume 124 Biographies 74: Xue Song, Ling Huzhuang, Tian Shengong, Hou Xiyi, Li Zhengji

meta.sourceNote: Body restored from Wikisource juan 124 to match the ChineseNotes chapter heading. The previous Wikisource import used the file number instead of the traditional juan.

sentences.zh: 薛嵩，絳州萬泉人。

translations.literal: Xue Song was a native of Wanquan in Jiang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Xue Song was a native of Wanquan in Jiang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 祖仁貴，高宗朝名將，封平陽郡公。

translations.literal: His grandfather Rengui was a famous general in the Gaozong reign and was enfeoffed as Duke of Pingyang Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather Xue Rengui was a celebrated general under Emperor Gaozong and was enfeoffed as Duke of Pingyang.

sentences.zh: 父楚玉，為范陽、平盧節度使。

translations.literal: His father Chuyu served as military commissioner of Fanyang and Pinglu.
translations.idiomatic: His father Xue Chuyu served as military commissioner of Fanyang and Pinglu.

sentences.zh: 嵩少以門廕，落拓不事家產，有膂力，善騎射，不知書。

translations.literal: In youth Song relied on hereditary privilege, was unrestrained and did not attend to family property, had physical strength, was skilled at mounted archery, and did not know books.
translations.idiomatic: In youth Xue Song relied on hereditary privilege, lived freely without tending family property, possessed great physical strength and skill in mounted archery, and had no learning in books.

sentences.zh: 自天下兵起，束身戎伍，委質逆徒。

translations.literal: When warfare arose throughout the realm, he bound himself to the army and pledged himself to the rebel band.
translations.idiomatic: When warfare engulfed the empire, he entered military service and pledged himself to the rebel cause.

sentences.zh: 廣德元年，東都平，時皇太子為天下兵馬元帥，遣仆固懷恩東收河朔。

translations.literal: In the first year of Guangde, when the Eastern Capital was pacified, the Crown Prince at that time was commander-in-chief of all military forces in the realm and dispatched Pugu Huai'en eastward to recover Hebei.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Guangde (763), after the Eastern Capital was pacified, the Crown Prince—then commander-in-chief of imperial forces—sent Pugu Huai'en east to recover Hebei.

sentences.zh: 嵩為賊守相州，聞賊朝義兵潰，王師至，嵩惶惑迎拜於懷恩馬前，懷恩釋之，令守舊職。

translations.literal: Song was defending Xiang Prefecture for the rebels; hearing that the rebel Chaoyi's army had collapsed and the imperial army had arrived, Song in alarm and confusion came forward to bow in submission before Huai'en's horse; Huai'en released him and ordered him to keep his former post.
translations.idiomatic: Xue Song was defending Xiang Prefecture for the rebels. When he heard that Chaoyi's forces had collapsed and the imperial army had arrived, he came forward in alarm to bow in submission before Huai'en's horse. Huai'en spared him and let him retain his former post.

sentences.zh: 時懷恩二心已萌。

translations.literal: At that time Huai'en's divided loyalty had already begun to sprout.
translations.idiomatic: By then Huai'en's divided loyalty had already begun to emerge.

sentences.zh: 懷恩平河朔旋，乃奏嵩及田承嗣、張忠誌、李懷仙分理河北道；

translations.literal: When Huai'en pacified Hebei and returned, he memorialized that Song, Tian Chengsi, Zhang Zhizhi, and Li Huaixian should separately administer the Hebei circuit;
translations.idiomatic: After pacifying Hebei and returning west, Huai'en memorialized that Xue Song, Tian Chengsi, Zhang Zhizhi, and Li Huaixian should each administer portions of the Hebei circuit.

sentences.zh: 詔遂以嵩為相州刺史，充相、衛、洺、邢等州節度觀察使，承嗣鎮魏州，忠誌鎮恆州，懷仙鎮幽州，各據數州之地。

translations.literal: the edict then appointed Song prefect of Xiang Prefecture and military commissioner and surveillance commissioner of Xiang, Wei, Ming, and Xing prefectures; Chengsi garrisoned Wei Prefecture, Zhizhi garrisoned Heng Prefecture, and Huaixian garrisoned You Prefecture, each holding several prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: The court accordingly appointed Xue Song prefect of Xiang Prefecture and military commissioner and surveillance commissioner over Xiang, Wei, Ming, and Xing; Tian Chengsi garrisoned Wei Prefecture, Zhang Zhizhi Heng Prefecture, and Li Huaixian You Prefecture, each controlling several prefectures.

sentences.zh: 時多事之後，姑欲安人，遂以重寄委嵩。

translations.literal: In that time after many troubles, the court wished only to settle the people and therefore entrusted Song with heavy responsibility.
translations.idiomatic: In those troubled times the court wished chiefly to reassure the populace and therefore entrusted Xue Song with heavy responsibility.

sentences.zh: 嵩感恩奉職，數年間，管內粗理，累遷檢校右僕射。

translations.literal: Song, grateful, fulfilled his duties; within several years the territory under his charge was roughly well ordered, and he was repeatedly promoted to acting right vice minister of works.
translations.idiomatic: Grateful, Xue Song devoted himself to his duties. Within several years the territory under his charge was roughly in order, and he rose repeatedly to acting right vice minister of works.

sentences.zh: 大歷八年正月卒。

translations.literal: In the first month of the eighth year of Dali he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the first month of the eighth year of Dali (773).

sentences.zh: 詔遣弟崿知留後，累加崿太子少師。

translations.literal: An edict dispatched his younger brother E to serve as acting commissioner; E was repeatedly promoted to junior tutor of the crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: An edict dispatched his younger brother Xue E to serve as acting commissioner; E was later promoted to junior tutor of the crown prince.

sentences.zh: 大歷十年正月丁酉，昭義軍兵馬使裴誌清盜所將兵逐崿，舉眾歸田承嗣以叛。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou of the first month of the tenth year of Dali, Pei Zhiqing, army-and-horse commissioner of the Zhaoyi Army, stole the troops he commanded, drove out E, and led the masses to Tian Chengsi in rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day of the first month of the tenth year of Dali (775), Pei Zhiqing, army-and-horse commissioner of the Zhaoyi Army, stole the troops under his command, drove out Xue E, and led his forces to Tian Chengsi in rebellion.

sentences.zh: 崿奔於洺州，上表乞入朝，許之。

translations.literal: E fled to Ming Prefecture and submitted a memorial requesting to enter court; permission was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Xue E fled to Ming Prefecture and submitted a memorial asking to come to court; permission was granted.

sentences.zh: 至京，素服於銀臺門待罪，詔釋之。

translations.literal: On reaching the capital he wore plain garments at the Yintai Gate to await punishment; an edict released him.
translations.idiomatic: On reaching the capital he wore plain garments at the Yintai Gate to await punishment; an edict released him.

sentences.zh: 嵩子平，年十二，為磁州刺史。

translations.literal: Song's son Ping, at age twelve, was prefect of Ci Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Xue Song's son Ping, at age twelve, was prefect of Ci Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 嵩卒，軍吏欲用河北故事，脅平知留後務，平偽許之，讓於叔父崿，一夕以喪歸。

translations.literal: When Song died, the army officers wished to follow the Hebei custom and coerce Ping to take charge of the acting commissioner's duties; Ping falsely agreed, yielded to his uncle E, and in one night returned with the funeral train.
translations.idiomatic: When Xue Song died, the army officers wished to follow Hebei custom and coerce Ping into taking charge as acting commissioner. Ping feigned agreement, yielded to his uncle E, and returned overnight with the funeral train.

sentences.zh: 及免喪，累授右衛將軍，在南衙凡三十年。

translations.literal: After mourning was completed he was repeatedly appointed right guard general and served in the southern offices for thirty years in all.
translations.idiomatic: After mourning was completed he was repeatedly appointed right guard general and served in the southern offices for thirty years altogether.

sentences.zh: 宰相杜黃裳深器之，薦為汝州刺史、兼御史中丞，理有能名。

translations.literal: Chief minister Du Huangshang greatly valued him and recommended him as prefect of Ru Prefecture and concurrently censor-in-chief; his governance won a reputation for ability.
translations.idiomatic: Chief minister Du Huangshang greatly valued him and recommended him as prefect of Ru Prefecture and concurrent censor-in-chief; his governance won a reputation for competence.

sentences.zh: 元和七年，淮西用兵，自左龍武大將軍授兼御史大夫、滑州刺史、鄭滑節度觀察等使，累有戰功。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Yuanhe, when troops were deployed against Huai West, he was transferred from left Longwu grand general to concurrent grand censor, prefect of Hua Prefecture, and military commissioner and surveillance commissioner of Zheng and Hua, and repeatedly achieved merit in battle.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year of Yuanhe (812), when troops were deployed against Huai West, he was transferred from left Longwu grand general to concurrent grand censor, prefect of Hua Prefecture, and military commissioner and surveillance commissioner of Zheng and Hua, winning repeated battle honors.

sentences.zh: 滑州城西距黃河二里，每歲常為水患。

translations.literal: West of Hua Prefecture city the Yellow River was two li distant, and every year there was commonly flooding.
translations.idiomatic: Two li west of Hua Prefecture city lay the Yellow River, which flooded the area nearly every year.

sentences.zh: 平詢訪得古河道，接衛州黎陽縣界。

translations.literal: Ping inquired and found an ancient river course reaching the border of Li Yang County in Wei Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Xue Ping investigated and found an ancient river course reaching the border of Li Yang County in Wei Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 平率魏博節度使田弘正同上聞，開古河南北長十四里，決舊河以分水勢，滑人遂無水患。

translations.literal: Ping led Tian Hongzheng, military commissioner of Weibo, to report jointly to the throne; they opened the ancient channel fourteen li north and south of the river, cut the old river to divide the water's force, and the people of Hua thereafter had no flood harm.
translations.idiomatic: Xue Ping joined Tian Hongzheng, military commissioner of Weibo, in reporting to the throne; they opened the ancient channel fourteen li north and south of the river, cut through the old course to divert the flood, and the people of Hua thereafter suffered no further inundation.

sentences.zh: 居鎮六年，入為左金吾大將軍。

translations.literal: After six years in command he entered court as left Golden Crow grand general.
translations.idiomatic: After six years in command he entered court as left Golden Crow grand general.

sentences.zh: 未幾，復為鄭滑節度觀察使。

translations.literal: Before long he was again made military commissioner and surveillance commissioner of Zheng and Hua.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was again appointed military commissioner and surveillance commissioner of Zheng and Hua.

sentences.zh: 及平李師道，朝廷以東平十二州析為三道，以淄、青、齊、登、萊五州為平盧軍，以平為節度、觀察等使，仍押新羅、渤海兩蕃使。

translations.literal: When Li Shidao was pacified, the court divided the twelve prefectures of Dongping into three circuits: Zi, Qing, Qi, Deng, and Lai—five prefectures—formed the Pinglu Army, and Ping was made military commissioner, surveillance commissioner, and the like, and still served as commissioner for the two foreign peoples of Silla and Bohai.
translations.idiomatic: When Li Shidao was pacified, the court divided Dongping's twelve prefectures into three circuits. Zi, Qing, Qi, Deng, and Lai—five prefectures—formed the Pinglu Army, and Xue Ping was made its military and surveillance commissioner while continuing as commissioner for Silla and Bohai.

sentences.zh: 長慶元年，幽鎮叛，杜叔良統橫海全軍討伐不勝，王庭湊圍牛元翼於深州。

translations.literal: In the first year of Changqing, You and Zhen rebelled; Du Shuliang commanded the entire Transocean Army in punitive attack but could not prevail, and Wang Tingcou besieged Niu Yuanji at Shen Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Changqing (821), You and Zhen rebelled. Du Shuliang led the entire Transocean Army in punitive attack but could not prevail, and Wang Tingcou besieged Niu Yuanji at Shen Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 棣州為賊所窘，朝廷乃委平以偏師援棣州，平即遣將李叔佐以兵五百救之。

translations.literal: Di Prefecture was hard pressed by the rebels, and the court therefore entrusted Ping with a detached force to relieve Di Prefecture; Ping immediately dispatched the general Li Shuzuo with five hundred troops to rescue it.
translations.idiomatic: Di Prefecture was hard pressed by the rebels, and the court entrusted Ping with a detached force to relieve it. Ping immediately sent the general Li Shuzuo with five hundred troops to the rescue.

sentences.zh: 居數月，刺史王稷饋給稍薄，兵士怨怒，叔佐不能戢，宵潰而歸。

translations.literal: After several months the prefect Wang Ji supplied provisions somewhat meagerly; the soldiers grew resentful and angry, and Shuzuo could not restrain them—they fled by night and returned.
translations.idiomatic: After several months Prefect Wang Ji's supplies grew meager. The soldiers grew resentful, and Shuzuo could not restrain them; they fled by night and returned.

sentences.zh: 仍推突將馬狼兒為帥，行及青城鎮，劫鎮將李自勸，並其眾；

translations.literal: They then pushed the assault officer Ma Lang'er to be commander; reaching Qingcheng Post, they robbed the post commander Li Ziqin and his forces as well;
translations.idiomatic: They then pushed the assault officer Ma Lang'er to be commander. Reaching Qingcheng Post they robbed Post Commander Li Ziqin and his forces as well.

sentences.zh: 次至博昌鎮，復劫其鎮兵，共得七千余人，徑逼青州城。

translations.literal: next at Bochang Post they again robbed its garrison troops, gathering more than seven thousand men in all, and pressed straight upon Qing Prefecture city.
translations.idiomatic: Next at Bochang Post they again robbed its garrison, gathering more than seven thousand men in all, and pressed straight upon Qing Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 城中兵士不敵，平悉府庫並家財募二千精卒，逆擊之，仍先以騎兵掩其家屬輜重，賊眾惶惑反顧，因大敗。

translations.literal: The soldiers in the city could not match them; Ping emptied the government storehouses and his household wealth to recruit two thousand elite troops, met and struck them, and first sent cavalry to cover their families and baggage; the rebel masses in alarm looked back, and so were greatly defeated.
translations.idiomatic: The city's defenders could not match them. Xue Ping emptied the government storehouses and his household wealth to recruit two thousand elite troops, met and struck them, and first sent cavalry to strike at their families and baggage. The rebel masses looked back in alarm and were routed.

sentences.zh: 狼兒與其同惡十數輩脫身竄匿，余黨降，稍後者斬於鞠場。

translations.literal: Lang'er and more than ten of his fellow evildoers escaped and hid; the rest surrendered, and those who lagged behind were beheaded at the drill ground.
translations.idiomatic: Lang'er and more than ten fellow evildoers escaped and hid; the rest surrendered, and stragglers were beheaded at the drill ground.

sentences.zh: 明日，狼兒亦就擒戮，脅從者放歸田裏。

translations.literal: The next day Lang'er too was captured and executed; those coerced to follow were released to return to their fields.
translations.idiomatic: The next day Lang'er too was captured and executed; those coerced into following were released to return to their fields.

sentences.zh: 詔加右僕射，進封魏國公，由是遠近畏伏平之威略。

translations.literal: An edict added the post of right vice minister of works and advanced his enfeoffment to Duke of Wei; from this near and far feared and submitted to Ping's martial prestige.
translations.idiomatic: An edict promoted him to right vice minister of works and advanced his enfeoffment to Duke of Wei; from this time near and far submitted to Xue Ping's martial prestige.

sentences.zh: 在鎮六周歲，兵甲完利，井賦均一。

translations.literal: In six full years in command, arms and armor were complete and sharp, and well-field taxes were uniform.
translations.idiomatic: In six full years in command, arms and armor were complete and sharp, and well-field taxes were uniform.

sentences.zh: 至是入覲，百姓遮道乞留，數日乃得出。

translations.literal: At this time he entered court for audience; the common people blocked the road begging him to remain, and only after several days could he get through.
translations.idiomatic: When he came to court for audience, common people blocked the road begging him to remain, and only after several days could he pass.

sentences.zh: 時人以為近日節制，罕有其比。

translations.literal: People of the time thought that among recent military commissioners few could compare with him.
translations.idiomatic: People of the time thought that among recent military commissioners few could compare with him.

sentences.zh: 寶歷元年，歸朝，進加檢校左僕射、兼戶部尚書。

translations.literal: In the first year of Baoli he returned to court and was further promoted to acting left vice minister of works and concurrent minister of revenue.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Baoli (825) he returned to court and was further promoted to acting left vice minister of works and concurrent minister of revenue.

sentences.zh: 逾月，復檢校司空，兼河中絳隰節度觀察等使。

translations.literal: After more than a month he was again made acting minister of works and concurrent military commissioner and surveillance commissioner of Hezhong, Jiang, and Xi.
translations.idiomatic: After more than a month he was again made acting minister of works and concurrent military commissioner and surveillance commissioner of Hezhong, Jiang, and Xi.

sentences.zh: 大和二年，復以晉州，慈州隸河中，益兵三千人，加平檢校司徒。

translations.literal: In the second year of Dahe, Jin and Ci prefectures were again placed under Hezhong, three thousand troops were added, and Ping was promoted to acting minister of education.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Dahe (828), Jin and Ci prefectures were again placed under Hezhong, three thousand troops were added, and Xue Ping was promoted to acting minister of education.

sentences.zh: 在河中凡六年，召拜太子太保。

translations.literal: In Hezhong for six years in all, he was summoned and appointed heir apparent's grand protector.
translations.idiomatic: After six years in Hezhong he was summoned and appointed heir apparent's grand protector.

sentences.zh: 明年，上疏乞老，以司徒致仕，居一年卒，冊贈太傅。

translations.literal: The next year he submitted a memorial begging to retire on account of age, was retired with the rank of minister of education, lived one year, and died; he was posthumously enfeoffed grand tutor.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he submitted a memorial begging to retire on account of age, retired with the rank of minister of education, lived one more year, and died; he was posthumously enfeoffed grand tutor.

sentences.zh: 嵩族子雄，初為嵩屬吏，知衛州事，嵩歿，特詔授衛州刺史。

translations.literal: Song's clansman Xiong at first was a subordinate official of Song's and knew the affairs of Wei Prefecture; when Song died, a special edict appointed him prefect of Wei Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Xue Song's clansman Xiong had first served as a subordinate official under Song and managed affairs in Wei Prefecture. When Song died, a special edict appointed him prefect of Wei Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 魏博節度田承嗣誘為亂，雄不從，承嗣遣刺客盜殺之。

translations.literal: Tian Chengsi, military commissioner of Weibo, enticed him to rebel; Xiong would not comply, and Chengsi dispatched assassins who stole in and killed him.
translations.idiomatic: Tian Chengsi, military commissioner of Weibo, enticed him to rebel. Xiong refused, and Chengsi dispatched assassins who stole in and killed him.

sentences.zh: 令狐彰，京兆富平人也。

translations.literal: Ling Huzhang was a native of Fuping in Jingzhao.
translations.idiomatic: Ling Huzhang was a native of Fuping in Jingzhao.

sentences.zh: 遠祖自燉煌徙家焉，代有冠冕。

translations.literal: A remote ancestor moved the family from Dunhuang, and for generations there were officials of cap and coronet.
translations.idiomatic: A remote ancestor had moved the family from Dunhuang, and for generations there were officials of rank and distinction.

sentences.zh: 父濞，天寶中任鄧州錄事參軍，以清白聞，本道采訪使宋鼎引為判官。

translations.literal: His father Bi, in the Tianbao era served as recorder of Deng Prefecture and was known for integrity; the circuit investigating commissioner Song Ding brought him in as aide.
translations.idiomatic: His father Ling Bi, in the Tianbao era served as recorder of Deng Prefecture and was known for integrity; the circuit investigating commissioner Song Ding brought him in as aide.

sentences.zh: 初任范陽縣尉，通幽州人女，生彰，及秩滿，留彰於母氏，彰遂少長范陽。

translations.literal: At first he served as magistrate of Fanyang County, married a woman of You Prefecture, and fathered Zhang; when his term ended he left Zhang with the mother's family, and Zhang thus grew up in Fanyang.
translations.idiomatic: At first he served as magistrate of Fanyang County, married a woman of You Prefecture, and fathered Zhang. When his term ended he left Zhang with the mother's family, and Zhang thus grew up in Fanyang.

sentences.zh: 倜儻有膽氣，涉獵書傳，粗知文義，善弓矢，乃策名從軍，事安祿山。

translations.literal: Bold and daring, with courage and spirit, he ranged through books and records and roughly knew literary meaning; skilled with bow and arrow, he then sought fame in the army and served An Lushan.
translations.idiomatic: Bold and daring, he read widely in books and records and had a rough grasp of literary meaning; skilled with bow and arrow, he then sought fame in the army and served An Lushan.

sentences.zh: 天福中，以軍功累遷至左衛員外郎將。

translations.literal: In the Tianfu era, through military merit he was repeatedly promoted to acting left guard assistant commandant.
translations.idiomatic: In the Tianfu era, through military merit he was repeatedly promoted to acting left guard assistant commandant.

sentences.zh: 安祿山叛逆，以本官隨賊黨張通儒赴京師，通儒偽署為城內左街使。

translations.literal: When An Lushan rebelled, with his original office he followed the rebel partisan Zhang Tongru to the capital; Tongru falsely appointed him left street commissioner within the city.
translations.idiomatic: When An Lushan rebelled, Ling Huzhang followed the rebel partisan Zhang Tongru to the capital with his original office; Tongru falsely appointed him left street commissioner within the city.

sentences.zh: 王師收復二京，隨通儒等遁走河朔，又陷逆賊史思明，偽署為博州刺史及滑州刺史，令統數千兵戍滑臺。

translations.literal: When the imperial army recovered the two capitals, he followed Tongru and others in flight to Hebei, then again fell to the rebel Shi Siming, who falsely appointed him prefect of Bo and prefect of Hua and ordered him to command several thousand troops garrisoning Huatai.
translations.idiomatic: When the imperial army recovered the two capitals, he fled with Tongru and others to Hebei, then fell again to the rebel Shi Siming, who falsely appointed him prefect of Bo and Hua and ordered him to command several thousand troops garrisoning Huatai.

sentences.zh: 彰感激忠義，思立名節，乃潛謀歸順。

translations.literal: Zhang, moved by loyalty and righteousness, wished to establish name and integrity, and therefore secretly plotted to return to allegiance.
translations.idiomatic: Moved by loyalty and righteousness, Ling Huzhang wished to establish his name and integrity and therefore secretly plotted to return to allegiance.

sentences.zh: 會中官楊萬定監滑州軍，彰遂募勇士善於水者，俾乘夜涉河，達表奏於萬定，請以所管賊一將兵馬及州縣歸順，萬定以聞。

translations.literal: It happened that the palace eunuch Yang Wanding was supervising the Hua Prefecture army; Zhang then recruited brave men skilled in water, had them cross the river by night, and reached Yang with a memorial requesting to bring the rebel general's troops and horses and the prefectures and counties under his command to allegiance; Wanding reported it.
translations.idiomatic: It happened that the palace eunuch Yang Wanding was supervising the Hua Prefecture army. Zhang recruited brave men skilled in water, had them cross the river by night, and reached Yang with a memorial asking to bring the rebel general's troops and the prefectures and counties under his command to allegiance; Wanding reported it.

sentences.zh: 自祿山構逆，為賊守者，未有舉州向化，肅宗得彰表，大悅，賜書慰勞。

translations.literal: From the time Lushan raised rebellion, of those who defended for the rebels none had turned an entire prefecture to allegiance; Emperor Suzong, receiving Zhang's memorial, was greatly pleased and bestowed a letter of consolation and encouragement.
translations.idiomatic: From the time Lushan raised rebellion, no defender of a rebel-held prefecture had turned an entire prefecture to allegiance. Emperor Suzong, receiving Zhang's memorial, was greatly pleased and sent a letter of consolation and encouragement.

sentences.zh: 時彰移鎮杏園渡，遂為思明所疑，思明乃遣所親薛岌統精卒圍杏園攻之。

translations.literal: At that time Zhang moved his command to Xingyuan Ford and was therefore suspected by Siming; Siming then dispatched his intimate Xue Ji to command elite troops to surround Xingyuan and attack.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Zhang moved his command to Xingyuan Ford and was therefore suspected by Siming. Siming dispatched his intimate Xue Ji to command elite troops to surround Xingyuan and attack.

sentences.zh: 彰乃明示三軍，曉以逆順，眾心感附，鹹悉力為用。

translations.literal: Zhang then openly showed the three armies and instructed them in rebellion and loyalty; the hearts of the masses were moved and attached, and all exerted their strength for his use.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang then openly addressed the three armies and instructed them in rebellion and loyalty. The troops were moved and attached, and all exerted their strength for his use.

sentences.zh: 與賊兵戰，大破之，潰圍而出，遂以麾下將士數百人隨萬定入朝。

translations.literal: He fought the rebel troops, greatly defeated them, broke out of the encirclement, and then followed Wanding into court with several hundred officers and soldiers under his command.
translations.idiomatic: He fought the rebel troops, routed them, broke out of the encirclement, and then followed Wanding into court with several hundred officers and soldiers under his command.

sentences.zh: 肅宗深獎之，禮甚優厚，賜甲第一區、名馬數匹，並帷帳什器頗盛，拜御史中丞，兼滑州刺史、滑毫魏博等六州節度，仍加銀青光祿大夫，鎮滑州，委平殘寇。

translations.literal: Emperor Suzong greatly rewarded him and treated him with exceptional favor, bestowing a first-rank residence, several famous horses, and abundant curtains, bedding, and utensils; he was appointed censor-in-chief, concurrently prefect of Hua Prefecture and military commissioner of the six prefectures of Hua, Bo, Wei, and the like, and additionally silver-ribbon grand master for splendid happiness; he garrisoned Hua Prefecture and was entrusted with pacifying remnant bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Suzong greatly rewarded him and treated him with exceptional favor, bestowing a first-rank residence, several famous horses, and abundant furnishings. He was appointed censor-in-chief, concurrently prefect of Hua and military commissioner of Hua, Bo, Wei, and three other prefectures, with the additional title silver-ribbon grand master for splendid happiness. He garrisoned Hua Prefecture and was entrusted with pacifying remnant bandits.

sentences.zh: 及史朝義滅，遷御史大夫，封霍國公，尋加檢校工部尚書。

translations.literal: When Shi Chaoyi was destroyed he was transferred to grand censor and enfeoffed Duke of Huo; soon he was additionally made acting minister of works.
translations.idiomatic: When Shi Chaoyi was destroyed he was transferred to grand censor and enfeoffed Duke of Huo; soon he was additionally made acting minister of works.

sentences.zh: 未幾，檢校右僕射，余並如故。

translations.literal: Before long he was made acting right vice minister of works, the rest remaining as before.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was made acting right vice minister of works, the rest remaining as before.

sentences.zh: 彰在職，風化大行。

translations.literal: In office Zhang's civilizing influence was greatly carried out.
translations.idiomatic: In office Ling Huzhang's civilizing influence was greatly carried out.

sentences.zh: 滑州瘡痍未復，城邑為墟，彰以身勵下，一誌農戰，內檢軍戎，外牧黎庶，法令嚴酷，人不敢犯。

translations.literal: Hua Prefecture's wounds were not yet healed and the cities were ruins; Zhang by his person encouraged those below, with one will devoted to farming and warfare, inwardly inspected the army, outwardly tended the common people; laws and orders were stern and severe, and people dared not offend.
translations.idiomatic: Hua Prefecture's wounds were not yet healed and its cities lay in ruins. Zhang by his own example encouraged those below, devoting himself to farming and warfare, inspecting the army within and tending the common people without. Laws and orders were stern and severe, and people dared not offend.

sentences.zh: 數年間，田疇大辟，庫藏充積，歲奉王稅及修貢獻，未嘗暫闕。

translations.literal: Within several years fields were greatly opened, storehouses filled and accumulated, and every year he presented royal taxes and sent tribute offerings without ever briefly failing.
translations.idiomatic: Within several years fields were greatly opened and storehouses filled. Every year he presented royal taxes and tribute offerings without ever failing.

sentences.zh: 時犬戎犯邊，征兵防秋。

translations.literal: At that time the dog Rong violated the frontier and troops were levied for autumn defense.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the Rong violated the frontier and troops were levied for autumn defense.

sentences.zh: 彰遣屬吏部統營伍，自滑至京之西郊，向二千餘里，甲士三千人，率自賚糧，所過州縣，路次供擬，皆讓而不受，經閭裏不犯秋毫，識者稱之。

translations.literal: Zhang dispatched a subordinate to organize the camps and battalions; from Hua to the western suburbs of the capital, along more than two thousand li, three thousand armored soldiers each supplied their own provisions; the prefectures and counties passed along the route offered provisions, all of which they declined and did not accept; passing through villages they did not violate the slightest thing—those who knew praised this.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang dispatched a subordinate to organize camps and battalions. From Hua to the western suburbs of the capital, along more than two thousand li, three thousand armored soldiers each supplied their own provisions. Prefectures and counties along the route offered provisions, all of which they declined. Passing through villages they violated nothing—the knowledgeable praised this.

sentences.zh: 然性識猜阻，人有忤意，不加省察，輒至斃踣，此其短也。

translations.literal: Yet his nature was suspicious and obstructive; when anyone offended his intent he did not investigate and straightway killed them—this was his shortcoming.
translations.idiomatic: Yet his nature was suspicious and obstructive. When anyone offended him he did not investigate and straightway killed them—this was his shortcoming.

sentences.zh: 臨終，手疏辭表，誡子以忠孝守節，又舉能自代。

translations.literal: At the end of his life he personally wrote a memorial of resignation, admonishing his sons to keep loyalty and filial piety and preserve integrity, and also recommended able men to replace himself.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of his life he personally wrote a memorial of resignation, admonishing his sons to keep loyalty, filial piety, and integrity, and also recommended able men to replace himself.

sentences.zh: 表曰：

translations.literal: The memorial said:
translations.idiomatic: The memorial said:

sentences.zh: 臣自事陛下，得備籓守，受恩則重，效節未終，長辭聖朝，痛入心骨，臣誠哀懇，頓首頓首。

translations.literal: Your servant, having served Your Majesty, attained to frontier defense, received heavy favor yet did not complete devoted service; long parting from the sacred court, pain enters heart and bone—your servant is truly mournful and earnest, bowing head, bowing head.
translations.idiomatic: Your servant, having served Your Majesty, attained to frontier defense and received heavy favor yet did not complete devoted service. Long parting from the sacred court, pain enters heart and bone—your servant is truly mournful and earnest, bowing head, bowing head.

sentences.zh: 臣受性剛拙，亦能包含。

translations.literal: Your servant's nature is blunt and awkward, yet can also be inclusive.
translations.idiomatic: Your servant's nature is blunt and awkward, yet can also be inclusive.

sentences.zh: 頃因魚朝恩將掠亳州，遂與臣結怨，當其縱暴，臣不敢入朝，專聽天誅，即欲奔謁。

translations.literal: Recently because Yu Chao'en was about to plunder Bo Prefecture he formed a grudge with your servant; when he indulged in violence your servant dared not enter court and could only await heaven's punishment, then wished to rush to audience.
translations.idiomatic: Recently, because Yu Chao'en was about to plunder Bo Prefecture he formed a grudge with your servant. When he indulged in violence your servant dared not enter court and could only await heaven's punishment, then wished to rush to audience.

sentences.zh: 及魚朝恩死，即臣屬疾苦，又遭家艱，力微眼暗，行動須人，拜舞不能，數月有闕。

translations.literal: When Yu Chao'en died, your servant then belonged to illness and again encountered family bereavement; strength slight, eyes dim, movement required another, bowing and dancing impossible—for several months there was absence.
translations.idiomatic: When Yu Chao'en died, your servant then suffered illness and again encountered family bereavement. Strength slight, eyes dim, movement required another, bowing and dancing impossible—for several months there was absence.

sentences.zh: 欲請替辭退，即日望稍瘳，冀得康強，榮歸朝覲。

translations.literal: Wishing to request replacement and withdrawal, on that very day hope was slightly recovered; hoping to regain health and strength, honorably return to court audience.
translations.idiomatic: Wishing to request replacement and withdrawal, on that very day hope was slightly recovered, hoping to regain health and strength and honorably return to court audience.

sentences.zh: 自冬末舊疾益重，瘡腫又生，氣息奄奄，遂期殞歿。

translations.literal: From late winter the old illness grew heavier, sores and swellings also arose, breath faint and feeble, and thus the term of death was reached.
translations.idiomatic: From late winter the old illness grew heavier, sores and swellings also arose, breath faint and feeble, and thus the term of death was reached.

sentences.zh: 不遂一朝天闕，一拜龍顏，臣禮不終，忠誠莫展，臣之大罪，下慚先代，仰愧聖朝。

translations.literal: Not attaining one morning at the heavenly gate, one bow to the dragon countenance—your servant's rites are incomplete, loyalty and devotion cannot be displayed; this is your servant's great fault, below ashamed before forebears, above ashamed before the sacred court.
translations.idiomatic: Not attaining one morning at the heavenly gate, one bow to the dragon countenance—your servant's rites are incomplete, loyalty and devotion cannot be displayed. This is your servant's great fault, below ashamed before forebears, above ashamed before the sacred court.

sentences.zh: 臣竭誠事上，誓立大節，天地神明，實知臣心。

translations.literal: Your servant devoted heart to serving above and vowed to establish great integrity; heaven, earth, and the bright spirits truly know your servant's heart.
translations.idiomatic: Your servant devoted heart to serving above and vowed to establish great integrity. Heaven, earth, and the bright spirits truly know your servant's heart.

sentences.zh: 心不遂行，言發自痛。

translations.literal: The heart does not attain to action; words issue from pain.
translations.idiomatic: The heart does not attain to action; words issue from pain.

sentences.zh: 當使倉糧錢絹羊馬牛畜一切已上，並先有部署；

translations.literal: Grain stores, money, silk, sheep, horses, cattle, and livestock—all the above—already had prior arrangements;
translations.idiomatic: Grain stores, money, silk, sheep, horses, cattle, and livestock—all the above—already had prior arrangements.

sentences.zh: 三軍兵士，州縣官吏等，各恭舊職，祗待聖恩。

translations.literal: the three armies' soldiers, prefectural and county officials, and the like each respectfully kept their old posts, awaiting the sacred favor.
translations.idiomatic: The three armies' soldiers, prefectural and county officials, and the like each respectfully kept their old posts, awaiting the sacred favor.

sentences.zh: 臣伏見吏部尚書劉晏及工部尚書李勉，知識忠貞，堪委大事，伏願陛下速令檢校，上副聖心。

translations.literal: Your servant has seen Minister of Personnel Liu Yan and Minister of Works Li Mian, who know loyalty and steadfastness and can be entrusted with great affairs; your servant humbly wishes Your Majesty to quickly order them inspected and confirmed, above matching the sacred heart.
translations.idiomatic: Your servant has seen Minister of Personnel Liu Yan and Minister of Works Li Mian, who know loyalty and steadfastness and can be entrusted with great affairs. Your servant humbly wishes Your Majesty to quickly order them inspected and confirmed, to match the sacred heart.

sentences.zh: 臣男建等，性不為非，行亦近道，今勒歸東都私第，使他年為臣報國，下慰幽魂。

translations.literal: Your servant's sons Jian and the like, whose natures are not given to wrongdoing and whose conduct is also near the Way, are now ordered to return to the private residence in the Eastern Capital so that in future years they may repay the state for your servant and below comfort the hidden soul.
translations.idiomatic: Your servant's sons Jian and the like, whose natures are not given to wrongdoing and whose conduct is also near the Way, are now ordered to return to the private residence in the Eastern Capital so that in future years they may repay the state for your servant and below comfort the hidden soul.

sentences.zh: 臨歿昏亂，伏表哀咽。

translations.literal: At the approach of death, confused, your servant humbly presents the memorial in choked grief.
translations.idiomatic: At the approach of death, confused, your servant humbly presents the memorial in choked grief.

sentences.zh: 上覽表，嗟悼久之。

translations.literal: The emperor, reading the memorial, sighed and mourned for a long time.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor, reading the memorial, sighed and mourned for a long time.

sentences.zh: 特下詔褒美曰：

translations.literal: A special edict praised and commended him, saying:
translations.idiomatic: A special edict praised and commended him, saying:

sentences.zh: 中衛社稷，外修疆事，合於一體，以靖庶邦，其在有終，謂之不朽。

translations.literal: Guarding the altars of state within and repairing frontier affairs without, joining in one body to bring peace to the myriad states—having this at the end is called imperishable.
translations.idiomatic: Guarding the altars of state within and repairing frontier affairs without, joining in one body to bring peace to the myriad states—having this at the end is called imperishable.

sentences.zh: 觀前代文武通賢，有匡時戡難，撻於大化，不忘時君，未嘗不嘉尚而流嘆也。

translations.literal: Observing civil and military worthies of former ages who aided the age and quelled hardship, who roused great transformation and did not forget the ruler of the time, never were they not admired and sighed over.
translations.idiomatic: Observing civil and military worthies of former ages who aided the age and quelled hardship, who roused great transformation and did not forget the ruler of the time, never were they not admired and sighed over.

sentences.zh: 今有忠烈之臣彰，剛直形外，純和積中，本於孝敬，輔以才略，統制籓閫，服勞王家。

translations.literal: Now there is the loyal and fierce minister Zhang, whose uprightness appears outwardly and whose pure harmony accumulates within, rooted in filial respect and aided by talent and strategy, controlling the frontier barrier and laboring for the royal house.
translations.idiomatic: Now there is the loyal and fierce minister Zhang, whose uprightness appears outwardly and whose pure harmony accumulates within, rooted in filial respect and aided by talent and strategy, controlling the frontier barrier and laboring for the royal house.

sentences.zh: 往以母老，躬於就養，豈不戀闕，以茲曠年。

translations.literal: In the past, because his mother was old, he personally went to provide for her; did he not yearn for the court? For this reason years were missed.
translations.idiomatic: In the past, because his mother was old, he personally went to provide for her. Did he not yearn for the court? For this reason years were missed.

sentences.zh: 及苴麻在艱，優諭權奪，踴絕傷足，淚盡喪明，入覲之期，良願莫遂。

translations.literal: When hemp mourning was in hardship, a gracious edict temporarily set it aside; leaping cut the foot, tears exhausted dimmed the eyes—the term of entering court, a good wish not attained.
translations.idiomatic: When hemp mourning was in hardship, a gracious edict temporarily set it aside. Leaping cut the foot, tears exhausted dimmed the eyes—the term of entering court, a good wish not attained.

sentences.zh: 想其風彩，久軫顧懷，遽見淪沒，用深追悼。

translations.literal: Thinking of his bearing and style, for long the heart was pained with care; suddenly seeing him sink and perish, therefore deep mourning was pursued.
translations.idiomatic: Thinking of his bearing and style, for long the heart was pained with care. Suddenly seeing him sink and perish, deep mourning was pursued.

sentences.zh: 嗟乎！

translations.literal: Alas!
translations.idiomatic: Alas!

sentences.zh: 方疾之時，以情自疏，無所有隱，見之於詞。

translations.literal: When ill, by feeling he made himself remote, hiding nothing, seen in the words.
translations.idiomatic: When ill, by feeling he made himself remote, hiding nothing, seen in the words.

sentences.zh: 復節守常，條上軍簿，請擇良帥，命於中朝。

translations.literal: Again preserving integrity and keeping constancy, item by item submitting the military registers, requesting selection of a good commander appointed from the central court.
translations.idiomatic: Again preserving integrity and keeping constancy, item by item submitting the military registers, requesting selection of a good commander appointed from the central court.

sentences.zh: 乃令遺胤，爰歸東洛，教忠以報國，約禮以居喪。

translations.literal: Then ordering the surviving heir to return to the eastern Luo, teaching loyalty to repay the state, binding ritual to observe mourning.
translations.idiomatic: Then ordering the surviving heir to return to the eastern Luo, teaching loyalty to repay the state, binding ritual to observe mourning.

sentences.zh: 古人所謂生不交利，死不屬其子，夫豈遠哉！

translations.literal: What the ancients called not mingling profit in life and not entrusting sons at death—is it not near!
translations.idiomatic: What the ancients called not mingling profit in life and not entrusting sons at death—is it not near!

sentences.zh: 節概誠亮，高絕無鄰，喟然感傷，鑒寐增慟。

translations.literal: Integrity and uprightness sincere and bright, lofty beyond neighbor—sighing in feeling, reflection in sleep increased grief.
translations.idiomatic: Integrity and uprightness sincere and bright, lofty beyond neighbor—sighing in feeling, reflection in sleep increased grief.

sentences.zh: 有以見東州士大夫勤王尊主之誌，用嘉其休，可以垂範，宣付史館，式昭名臣。

translations.literal: Thereby one sees the will of the eastern province's scholar-officials to serve the king and honor the ruler; therefore his excellence is praised, that it may be handed down as model; it is ordered transmitted to the Historiography Office to glorify the name of the minister.
translations.idiomatic: Thereby one sees the will of the eastern province's scholar-officials to serve the king and honor the ruler. Therefore his excellence is praised that it may be handed down as model; it is ordered transmitted to the Historiography Office to glorify the name of the minister.

sentences.zh: 子建、運、通。

translations.literal: His sons were Jian, Yun, and Tong.
translations.idiomatic: His sons were Jian, Yun, and Tong.

sentences.zh: 建，大歷四年十二月，彰遣入朝，特加兼御史中丞，歸滑州。

translations.literal: Jian, in the twelfth month of the fourth year of Dali, Zhang dispatched him to enter court; he was specially additionally appointed concurrent censor-in-chief and returned to Hua Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Jian, in the twelfth month of the fourth year of Dali (769), Zhang dispatched him to enter court. He was specially additionally appointed concurrent censor-in-chief and returned to Hua Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 及彰卒，滑三軍逼奪情禮，建守死不從，舉家歸京師。

translations.literal: When Zhang died, the three armies of Hua coerced and seized the mourning rites; Jian held to death and would not comply, and led the whole family to return to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhang died, the three armies of Hua coerced and seized the mourning rites. Jian held firm and would not comply, and led the whole family to return to the capital.

sentences.zh: 服闋，累轉至右龍虎軍使。

translations.literal: When mourning was completed he was repeatedly transferred up to dragon-tiger army commander of the right.
translations.idiomatic: When mourning was completed he was repeatedly transferred up to dragon-tiger army commander of the right.

sentences.zh: 德宗以涇原兵亂，出幸奉天，建方教射於軍中，遂以四百人隨駕為後殿。

translations.literal: Emperor Dezong, when the Jingyuan troops rebelled, went out to favor Fengtian; Jian was just then teaching archery in the army and therefore followed with four hundred men as rear guard for the imperial progress.
translations.idiomatic: When the Jingyuan troops rebelled, Emperor Dezong went out to favor Fengtian. Jian was just then teaching archery in the army and therefore followed with four hundred men as rear guard for the imperial progress.

sentences.zh: 至奏天，以建為行在中軍鼓角使。

translations.literal: On reaching Zoutian he was made drum-and-horn commissioner of the central army in the traveling court.
translations.idiomatic: On reaching Zoutian he was made drum-and-horn commissioner of the central army in the traveling court.

sentences.zh: 幸梁州，轉行在右廂兵馬使、右羽林大將軍、兼御史大夫。

translations.literal: When the emperor favored Liang Prefecture he was transferred to traveling-court right wing army-and-horse commissioner, right Feathered Forest grand general, and concurrent grand censor.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor favored Liang Prefecture he was transferred to traveling-court right wing army-and-horse commissioner, right Feathered Forest grand general, and concurrent grand censor.

sentences.zh: 興元元年六月，加檢校左散騎常侍、行在都知兵馬使、左神武大將軍。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the first year of Xingyuan he was additionally made acting left regular attendant of scattered cavalry, traveling-court director of army-and-horse affairs, and left Divine Martial grand general.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the first year of Xingyuan (784) he was additionally made acting left regular attendant of scattered cavalry, traveling-court director of army-and-horse affairs, and left Divine Martial grand general.

sentences.zh: 建妻李氏，恆帥寶臣女也，建惡，將棄之，乃誣與傭教生邢士倫奸通。

translations.literal: Jian's wife Lady Li was the daughter of Heng military commissioner Bao Chen; Jian detested her and was about to abandon her, and therefore falsely accused her of adultery with the hired tutor Xing Shilun.
translations.idiomatic: Jian's wife Lady Li was the daughter of Heng military commissioner Bao Chen. Jian detested her and was about to abandon her, and therefore falsely accused her of adultery with the hired tutor Xing Shilun.

sentences.zh: 建召士倫榜殺之，因逐其妻。

translations.literal: Jian summoned Shilun and had him beaten to death, then drove out his wife.
translations.idiomatic: Jian summoned Shilun and had him beaten to death, then drove out his wife.

sentences.zh: 士倫母聞，不勝其痛，卒。

translations.literal: Shilun's mother, hearing this, could not bear the pain and died.
translations.idiomatic: Shilun's mother, hearing this, could not bear the pain and died.

sentences.zh: 李氏奏請按劾，詔令三司詰之。

translations.literal: Lady Li submitted a request for investigation and prosecution; an edict ordered the three offices to interrogate the matter.
translations.idiomatic: Lady Li submitted a request for investigation and prosecution. An edict ordered the three offices to interrogate the matter.

sentences.zh: 李氏及奴婢款證，被誣頗明白，建方自首伏。

translations.literal: Lady Li and the maidservants' confessions and evidence made the false accusation quite clear; Jian then confessed voluntarily.
translations.idiomatic: Lady Li and the maidservants' confessions and evidence made the false accusation quite clear. Jian then confessed voluntarily.

sentences.zh: 建會赦免坐。

translations.literal: Jian encountered an amnesty and was exempted from punishment.
translations.idiomatic: Jian encountered an amnesty and was exempted from punishment.

sentences.zh: 德宗詔曰：「子育黎元，未能禁暴，在予之責，用軫於懷。

translations.literal: Emperor Dezong's edict said: "In nurturing the black-haired people, I have been unable to forbid violence; the responsibility lies with me, and my heart is pained thereby.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Dezong's edict said: "In nurturing the black-haired people, I have been unable to forbid violence; the responsibility lies with me, and my heart is pained thereby.

sentences.zh: 宜輟常膳五百千文，充葬士倫母子。

translations.literal: It is fitting to suspend ordinary meals to the amount of five hundred thousand cash to pay for burying Shilun and his mother.
translations.idiomatic: It is fitting to suspend ordinary meals to the amount of five hundred thousand cash to pay for burying Shilun and his mother.

sentences.zh: 其父既衰耄，至無所歸，良深矜念，委京兆尹厚加存恤。」

translations.literal: His father is already aged and decrepit, reaching the point of having nowhere to return; this deeply moves compassionate concern—entrust the metropolitan governor of Jingzhao to generously add support and comfort."
translations.idiomatic: His father is already aged and decrepit, reaching the point of having nowhere to return; this deeply moves compassionate concern—entrust the metropolitan governor of Jingzhao to generously add support and comfort."

sentences.zh: 貞元四年七月，以前官為右領軍大將軍。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the fourth year of Zhenyuan he was made right commanding army grand general with his former office.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the fourth year of Zhenyuan (788) he was made right commanding army grand general with his former office.

sentences.zh: 五年三月，以專殺不辜，德宗念舊勛，特容貸之；

translations.literal: In the third month of the fifth year, for unauthorized killing of the innocent, Dezong, mindful of old merit, specially granted leniency;
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the fifth year, for unauthorized killing of the innocent, Dezong, mindful of old merit, specially granted leniency.

sentences.zh: 復陳訴，詞甚虛罔，遂貶旋州別駕同正，卒於貶所。

translations.literal: he again submitted a complaint, his words very false and deceptive, and was therefore demoted to Xuan Prefecture vice prefect of equal rank and died in the place of demotion.
translations.idiomatic: He again submitted a complaint, his words very false and deceptive, and was therefore demoted to Xuan Prefecture vice prefect of equal rank and died in the place of demotion.

sentences.zh: 貞元六年九月，贈右領軍大將軍。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the sixth year of Zhenyuan he was posthumously enfeoffed right commanding army grand general.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the sixth year of Zhenyuan (790) he was posthumously enfeoffed right commanding army grand general.

sentences.zh: 十年，贈揚州大都督。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he was posthumously enfeoffed metropolitan governor of Yang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he was posthumously enfeoffed metropolitan governor of Yang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 運為東都留守將，逐賊出郊，其日有劫轉運絹於道者，杜亞以運豪家子，意其為之，乃令判官穆員及從事張弘靖同鞠其事。

translations.literal: Yun was an Eastern Capital garrison general; driving rebels out of the suburbs, on that day there was robbery of transport silk on the road; Du Ya, thinking Yun the son of a powerful family, suspected he had done it and therefore ordered aide Mu Yuan and attendant Zhang Hongjing jointly to try the matter.
translations.idiomatic: Yun was an Eastern Capital garrison general. While driving rebels out of the suburbs, on that day transport silk was robbed on the road. Du Ya, thinking Yun the son of a powerful family, suspected he had done it and therefore ordered aide Mu Yuan and attendant Zhang Hongjing jointly to try the matter.

sentences.zh: 員與弘靖皆以運職在牙門，必不為盜，抗請不按。

translations.literal: Yuan and Hongjing both held that Yun's duty was at the headquarters gate and he certainly would not be the thief; they resisted and requested that the case not be pressed.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan and Hongjing both held that Yun's duty was at the headquarters gate and he certainly would not be the thief. They resisted and requested that the case not be pressed.

sentences.zh: 亞不聽，而怒斥逐員等，令親事將武金鞫之。

translations.literal: Ya would not listen but angrily rebuked and expelled Yuan and the others, ordering his personal attendant General Wu Jin to interrogate it.
translations.idiomatic: Ya would not listen but angrily rebuked and expelled Yuan and the others, ordering his personal attendant General Wu Jin to interrogate it.

sentences.zh: 金笞箠運從者十余人，一人笞死，九人不勝考掠自誣，竟無贓狀。

translations.literal: Jin flogged more than ten of Yun's attendants; one man was flogged to death, nine could not bear the torture and falsely confessed themselves, yet in the end there was no evidence of stolen goods.
translations.idiomatic: Jin flogged more than ten of Yun's attendants. One man was flogged to death; nine could not bear the torture and falsely confessed, yet in the end there was no evidence of stolen goods.

sentences.zh: 亞具以聞，請流運於嶺表。

translations.literal: Ya fully reported it and requested that Yun be banished to the Ling region.
translations.idiomatic: Ya fully reported it and requested that Yun be banished to the Ling region.

sentences.zh: 德宗令侍御史李元素、刑部員外崔從質、大理司直盧士瞻三司覆按運獄，既竟，明運跡非行盜，以曾捕掠人於家，配流歸州。

translations.literal: Dezong ordered attendant censor Li Yuansu, vice director of the Ministry of Punishments Cui Congzhi, and chief clerk of the Court of Judicial Review Lu Shizhan of the three offices to reexamine Yun's case; when finished, it was clear Yun's traces were not those of a thief in action; for having once captured and plundered people at home he was banished to Gui Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Dezong ordered attendant censor Li Yuansu, vice director of the Ministry of Punishments Cui Congzhi, and chief clerk of the Court of Judicial Review Lu Shizhan of the three offices to reexamine Yun's case. When finished, it was clear Yun's traces were not those of a thief in action. For having once captured and plundered people at home he was banished to Gui Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 武金肆虐作威，教人通款，配流建州。

translations.literal: Wu Jin wantonly exercised power and taught people to confess falsely; he was banished to Jian Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Jin wantonly exercised power and taught people to confess falsely; he was banished to Jian Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 後歲餘，齊抗捕得劫轉運絹賊郭鵠、硃瞿曇等七人及贓絹，詔令杜亞與留臺同劾之，皆首伏。

translations.literal: More than a year later, Qi Kang captured the robbers of transport silk Guo Hu and Zhu Qutan and seven others together with the stolen silk; an edict ordered Du Ya and the Eastern Capital regent jointly to impeach them, and all confessed at the head.
translations.idiomatic: More than a year later, Qi Kang captured the robbers of transport silk Guo Hu and Zhu Qutan and seven others together with the stolen silk. An edict ordered Du Ya and the Eastern Capital regent jointly to impeach them, and all confessed at the head.

sentences.zh: 然終不原運，運死於歸州，眾冤之。

translations.literal: Yet in the end Yun was not pardoned; Yun died in Gui Prefecture, and the masses considered it injustice.
translations.idiomatic: Yet in the end Yun was not pardoned. Yun died in Gui Prefecture, and the masses considered it injustice.

sentences.zh: 通，元和中，宰相李吉甫奏曰：「臣伏見代宗朝滑州節度使令狐彰臨終上表，悉以土地兵甲籍上朝廷，遣諸子隨表歸闕。

translations.literal: Tong, in the Yuanhe era, chief minister Li Jifu memorialized, saying: "Your servant has seen that in the Daizong reign the Hua Prefecture military commissioner Ling Huzhang, at the end of his life, submitted a memorial fully registering land, troops, and armor with the court and dispatching his sons to follow the memorial to court.
translations.idiomatic: Tong, in the Yuanhe era, chief minister Li Jifu memorialized, saying: "Your servant has seen that in the Daizong reign the Hua Prefecture military commissioner Ling Huzhang, at the end of his life, submitted a memorial fully registering land, troops, and armor with the court and dispatching his sons to follow the memorial to court.

sentences.zh: 代宗以彰遺表宣示百僚，當時在位者聞之，無不感嘆。

translations.literal: Daizong displayed Zhang's testamentary memorial to the hundred officials; those then in office, hearing it, none were not moved and sighed.
translations.idiomatic: Daizong displayed Zhang's testamentary memorial to the hundred officials. Those then in office, hearing it, none were not moved and sighed.

sentences.zh: 今有次子通在。

translations.literal: Now the second son Tong survives.
translations.idiomatic: Now the second son Tong survives.

sentences.zh: 臣每感彰同進河朔諸鎮，付子傳孫，無不燻灼數代；

translations.literal: Your servant each time is moved that Zhang, together advancing with the Hebei military commissioners, handed sons to pass to grandsons, all scorching for several generations;
translations.idiomatic: Your servant each time is moved that Zhang, together advancing with the Hebei military commissioners, handed sons to pass to grandsons, all scorching for several generations.

sentences.zh: 唯彰忠義感激，奉國忘家，遣子入朝，以土地歸於先帝。

translations.literal: only Zhang, moved by loyalty and righteousness, served the state and forgot family, dispatched sons to enter court, and returned land to the former emperor.
translations.idiomatic: Only Zhang, moved by loyalty and righteousness, served the state and forgot family, dispatched sons to enter court, and returned land to the former emperor.

sentences.zh: 貞元中，長子建坐事死於施州，幼子運亦無罪流於歸州，欲使忠義之人，何所激勸？

translations.literal: In the Zhenyuan era the eldest son Jian sat in a matter and died in Shi Prefecture; the youngest son Yun also was banished without guilt to Gui Prefecture—wishing to make loyal and righteous men, where is the encouragement?
translations.idiomatic: In the Zhenyuan era the eldest son Jian sat in a matter and died in Shi Prefecture; the youngest son Yun also was banished without guilt to Gui Prefecture—wishing to make loyal and righteous men, where is the encouragement?

sentences.zh: 今通幸存，得遇明聖，伏乞陛下召之與語，如堪用，望垂獎錄。」

translations.literal: Now Tong fortunately survives and meets enlightened sagacity; your servant humbly begs Your Majesty to summon him to speak; if he is fit for use, I hope you will bestow reward and record."
translations.idiomatic: Now Tong fortunately survives and meets enlightened sagacity. Your servant humbly begs Your Majesty to summon him to speak. If he is fit for use, I hope you will bestow reward and record."

sentences.zh: 憲宗念彰之忠，即授通贊善大夫，出為宿州刺史。

translations.literal: Emperor Xianzong, mindful of Zhang's loyalty, immediately appointed Tong aide to the heir apparent and sent him out as prefect of Su Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xianzong, mindful of Zhang's loyalty, immediately appointed Tong aide to the heir apparent and sent him out as prefect of Su Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 時討淮、蔡，用為泗州刺史。

translations.literal: At that time in the campaign against Huai and Cai he was used as prefect of Si Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: At that time in the campaign against Huai and Cai he was used as prefect of Si Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 歲中改壽州團練使、檢校御史中丞。

translations.literal: Within the year he was changed to defense commissioner of Shou Prefecture and acting censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Within the year he was changed to defense commissioner of Shou Prefecture and acting censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 每與賊戰，必虛張虜獲，得賊數人，即為露布上之。

translations.literal: Each time he fought the rebels he necessarily inflated captive booty; obtaining several rebels he at once made a victory bulletin and submitted it above.
translations.idiomatic: Each time he fought the rebels he necessarily inflated captive booty. Obtaining several rebels he at once made a victory bulletin and submitted it above.

sentences.zh: 宰相武元衡笑而不奏；

translations.literal: Chief minister Wu Yuanheng laughed and did not memorialize it;
translations.idiomatic: Chief minister Wu Yuanheng laughed and did not memorialize it.

sentences.zh: 如有敗衄，即不敢上聞。

translations.literal: if there was defeat he then dared not report it above.
translations.idiomatic: If there was defeat he then dared not report it above.

sentences.zh: 後為賊所攻，境上城柵並陷，通走固州城，閉壁不出。

translations.literal: Later he was attacked by rebels; frontier city palisades all fell; Tong fled to Gu Prefecture city and closed the walls without coming out.
translations.idiomatic: Later he was attacked by rebels. Frontier city palisades all fell. Tong fled to Gu Prefecture city and closed the walls without coming out.

sentences.zh: 憲宗遣李文通往宣慰，度其將至，遂令代通，貶為昭州司戶，移撫州司馬。

translations.literal: Xianzong dispatched Li Wentong to go comfort and reassure; estimating that he was about to arrive, he then ordered him to replace Tong and demoted Tong to registrar of Zhao Prefecture and transferred him to prefectural aide of Fu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Xianzong dispatched Li Wentong to go comfort and reassure. Estimating that he was about to arrive, he then ordered him to replace Tong and demoted Tong to registrar of Zhao Prefecture and transferred him to prefectural aide of Fu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 十四年，征為右衛將軍，制下，給事中崔植封還制書，言通前刺壽州失律，不宜遽加獎任。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year he was summoned as right guard general; when the order was issued, supervisory attendant Cui Zhi sealed and returned the order document, saying Tong had earlier governed Shou Prefecture with failure in discipline and should not suddenly receive reward and appointment.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year he was summoned as right guard general. When the order was issued, supervisory attendant Cui Zhi sealed and returned the order document, saying Tong had earlier governed Shou Prefecture with failure in discipline and should not suddenly receive reward and appointment.

sentences.zh: 憲宗令宰相宣喻門下，言通父有功於國，不宜逐棄其子，制命方行。

translations.literal: Xianzong ordered the chief ministers to explain to the Gate Department that Tong's father had merit for the state and his son should not be cast away one by one; the order then proceeded.
translations.idiomatic: Xianzong ordered the chief ministers to explain to the Gate Department that Tong's father had merit for the state and his son should not be cast away one by one; the order then proceeded.

sentences.zh: 歲餘，出為淄州刺史。

translations.literal: After more than a year he went out as prefect of Zi Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: After more than a year he went out as prefect of Zi Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 長慶初，入為左衛大將軍，卒。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Changqing he entered court as left guard grand general and died.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Changqing he entered court as left guard grand general and died.

sentences.zh: 田神功，冀州人也，。

translations.literal: Tian Shengong was a native of Ji Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Tian Shengong was a native of Ji Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 家本微賤。

translations.literal: His family was originally low and humble.
translations.idiomatic: His family was originally low and humble.

sentences.zh: 天寶末，為縣裏胥，會河朔兵興，從事幽、薊。

translations.literal: At the end of the Tianbao era he was a district clerk; when troops arose in Hebei he followed affairs in You and Ji.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of the Tianbao era he was a district clerk. When troops arose in Hebei he followed affairs in You and Ji.

sentences.zh: 上元元年，為平盧節度都知兵馬使，兼鴻臚卿，於鄭州破賊四千余眾，生擒逆賊大將四人，牛馬器械不可勝數。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shangyuan he was director of army-and-horse affairs of the Pinglu military commission and concurrently grand master of splendid happiness; at Zheng Prefecture he defeated more than four thousand rebel troops, captured alive four great rebel generals, and oxen, horses, and weapons beyond counting.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Shangyuan (761) he was director of army-and-horse affairs of the Pinglu military commission and concurrently grand master of splendid happiness. At Zheng Prefecture he defeated more than four thousand rebel troops, captured alive four great rebel generals, and oxen, horses, and weapons beyond counting.

sentences.zh: 尋為鄧景山所引，至揚州，大掠百姓商人資產，郡內比屋發掘略遍，商胡波斯被殺者數千人。

translations.literal: Soon he was brought in by Deng Jingshan to Yang Prefecture, where he greatly plundered the assets of common people and merchants; within the commandery nearly every household was dug up and robbed throughout, and several thousand Sogdian and Persian merchants were killed.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was brought in by Deng Jingshan to Yang Prefecture, where he greatly plundered the assets of common people and merchants. Within the commandery nearly every household was dug up and robbed throughout, and several thousand Sogdian and Persian merchants were killed.

sentences.zh: 二年二月，生擒逆賊劉展，送於闕下。

translations.literal: In the second month of the second year he captured alive the rebel Liu Zhan and sent him to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the second year he captured alive the rebel Liu Zhan and sent him to the capital.

sentences.zh: 以擒展功，累遷檢校工部尚書、兼御史大夫、汴宋等八州節度使。

translations.literal: For the merit of capturing Zhan he was repeatedly promoted to acting minister of works, concurrent grand censor, and military commissioner of the eight prefectures including Bian and Song.
translations.idiomatic: For the merit of capturing Zhan he was repeatedly promoted to acting minister of works, concurrent grand censor, and military commissioner of the eight prefectures including Bian and Song.

sentences.zh: 大歷三年三月，朝京師，獻馬十匹、金銀器五十件、繒彩一萬匹。

translations.literal: In the third month of the third year of Dali he came to court at the capital and presented ten horses, fifty gold and silver vessels, and ten thousand bolts of silk.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the third year of Dali (768) he came to court at the capital and presented ten horses, fifty gold and silver vessels, and ten thousand bolts of silk.

sentences.zh: 時郭子儀入朝，請宴宰臣等於私第，神功效其請，亦以許之。

translations.literal: At that time Guo Ziyi entered court and requested to banquet the chief ministers and others at his private residence; Shengong imitated his request and was also granted permission.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Guo Ziyi entered court and requested to banquet the chief ministers and others at his private residence. Shengong imitated his request and was also granted permission.

sentences.zh: 尋加檢校右僕射，赴尚書省視事，特詔宰臣已下百官送上，仍加知省事以寵之。

translations.literal: Soon he was additionally made acting right vice minister of works, went to the Ministry of Works to handle affairs, and a special edict ordered chief ministers and below and the hundred officials to escort him up; he was additionally made director of ministry affairs to honor him.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was additionally made acting right vice minister of works, went to the Ministry of Works to handle affairs, and a special edict ordered chief ministers and below and the hundred officials to escort him up. He was additionally made director of ministry affairs to honor him.

sentences.zh: 神功忠樸幹勇，當時所稱。

translations.literal: Shengong was loyal, plain, capable, and brave—what people of the time praised.
translations.idiomatic: Shengong was loyal, plain, capable, and brave—what people of the time praised.

sentences.zh: 八年冬，復覲闕廷，遘疾，信宿而終。

translations.literal: In the winter of the eighth year he again viewed the court hall, encountered illness, and after one or two nights died.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of the eighth year he again viewed the court hall, encountered illness, and after one or two nights died.

sentences.zh: 上悼惜，為之徹樂，廢朝三日；

translations.literal: The emperor mourned and regretted, for him withdrew music, and suspended court for three days;
translations.idiomatic: The emperor mourned and regretted, for him withdrew music, and suspended court for three days.

sentences.zh: 贈司徒，賻絹一千匹、布五百端；

translations.literal: he was posthumously enfeoffed minister of education and granted one thousand bolts of silk and five hundred bolts of cloth as funeral gifts;
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously enfeoffed minister of education and granted one thousand bolts of silk and five hundred bolts of cloth as funeral gifts.

sentences.zh: 特許百官吊喪，賜屏風茵褥於靈座，並賜千僧齋以追福，至德已來，將帥不兼三事者，哀榮無比。

translations.literal: special permission was granted for the hundred officials to mourn at the funeral, screens, cushions, and bedding at the spirit seat, and a thousand-monk feast to pursue blessing—for generals since Zhide not combining three honors, mourning glory had no comparison.
translations.idiomatic: Special permission was granted for the hundred officials to mourn at the funeral, screens, cushions, and bedding at the spirit seat, and a thousand-monk feast to pursue blessing. For generals since Zhide not combining three honors, mourning glory had no comparison.

sentences.zh: 弟神玉，自曹州刺史權汴州留後。

translations.literal: His younger brother Shenyu, from prefect of Cao, acted as acting commissioner of Bian Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: His younger brother Shenyu, from prefect of Cao, acted as acting commissioner of Bian Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 大歷十年正月，加檢校兵部郎中、兼御史中丞，為汴州刺史，知汴州節度觀察留後事並河陽、澤潞等兵馬，直據淇門，會李承昭討魏博田承嗣。

translations.literal: In the first month of the tenth year of Dali he was additionally made acting director of the Bureau of Military Affairs and concurrent censor-in-chief, made prefect of Bian Prefecture, and knew Bian Prefecture military commission surveillance acting commissioner affairs together with Heyang, Ze, and Lu troops and horses, directly holding Qimen, joining Li Chengzhao in attacking Weibo's Tian Chengsi.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the tenth year of Dali (775) he was additionally made acting director of the Bureau of Military Affairs and concurrent censor-in-chief, made prefect of Bian Prefecture, and knew Bian Prefecture military commission surveillance acting commissioner affairs together with Heyang, Ze, and Lu troops and horses, directly holding Qimen, joining Li Chengzhao in attacking Weibo's Tian Chengsi.

sentences.zh: 十一年卒，詔滑州李勉代之。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he died; an edict ordered Li Mian of Hua Prefecture to replace him.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he died. An edict ordered Li Mian of Hua Prefecture to replace him.

sentences.zh: 侯希逸，平盧人也。

translations.literal: Hou Xiyi was a native of Pinglu.
translations.idiomatic: Hou Xiyi was a native of Pinglu.

sentences.zh: 少習武藝。

translations.literal: In youth he studied martial arts.
translations.idiomatic: In youth he studied martial arts.

sentences.zh: 天寶末，安祿山反，署其腹心徐歸道為平盧節度。

translations.literal: At the end of the Tianbao era An Lushan rebelled and appointed his intimate Xu Guidao military commissioner of Pinglu.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of the Tianbao era An Lushan rebelled and appointed his intimate Xu Guidao military commissioner of Pinglu.

sentences.zh: 希逸時為平盧裨將，率兵與安東都護王玄誌襲殺歸道，使以聞，詔以玄誌為平盧節度使。

translations.literal: Xiyi at that time was a Pinglu assistant general; he led troops with Protector-General of Andong Wang Xuanzhi to attack and kill Guidao, made it known, and an edict appointed Xuanzhi military commissioner of Pinglu.
translations.idiomatic: Xiyi at that time was a Pinglu assistant general. He led troops with Protector-General of Andong Wang Xuanzhi to attack and kill Guidao, made it known, and an edict appointed Xuanzhi military commissioner of Pinglu.

sentences.zh: 乾元元年冬，玄誌病卒，軍人共推立希逸為平盧軍使，朝廷因授節度使。

translations.literal: In the winter of the first year of Qianyuan Xuanzhi died of illness; the soldiers together pushed and established Xiyi as Pinglu army commander, and the court therefore appointed him military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of the first year of Qianyuan (758) Xuanzhi died of illness. The soldiers together pushed and established Xiyi as Pinglu army commander, and the court therefore appointed him military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 既數為賊所迫，希逸率勵將士，累破賊徒向潤客、李懷仙等。

translations.literal: Having repeatedly been pressed by rebels, Xiyi encouraged and led officers and soldiers and repeatedly defeated rebel partisans Xiang Runkuo and Li Huaixian and the like.
translations.idiomatic: Having repeatedly been pressed by rebels, Xiyi encouraged and led officers and soldiers and repeatedly defeated rebel partisans Xiang Runkuo and Li Huaixian and the like.

sentences.zh: 既淹歲月，且無救援，又為奚虜所侵，希逸拔其軍二萬余人，且行且戰，遂達於青州。

translations.literal: Having dragged on for months and with no rescue, and again invaded by Xi barbarians, Xiyi drew out his army of more than twenty thousand men, marching and fighting as he went, and thus reached Qing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Having dragged on for months with no rescue, and again invaded by Xi barbarians, Xiyi drew out his army of more than twenty thousand men, marching and fighting as he went, and thus reached Qing Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 會田神功、能元皓於兗州，青州遂陷於希逸，詔就加希逸為平盧、淄青節度使。

translations.literal: It happened that Tian Shengong and Neng Yuanhao were at Yan Prefecture; Qing Prefecture then fell to Xiyi, and an edict immediately additionally made Xiyi military commissioner of Pinglu and Zi and Qing.
translations.idiomatic: It happened that Tian Shengong and Neng Yuanhao were at Yan Prefecture. Qing Prefecture then fell to Xiyi, and an edict immediately additionally made Xiyi military commissioner of Pinglu and Zi and Qing.

sentences.zh: 自是迄今，淄青節度皆帶平盧之名也。

translations.literal: From this to the present, Zi and Qing military commissioners all bore the name Pinglu.
translations.idiomatic: From this to the present, Zi and Qing military commissioners all bore the name Pinglu.

sentences.zh: 希逸初領淄青，甚著聲稱，理兵務農，遠近美之。

translations.literal: When Xiyi first took command of Zi and Qing his reputation was very prominent; he ordered troops and tended farming, and near and far praised him.
translations.idiomatic: When Xiyi first took command of Zi and Qing his reputation was very prominent. He ordered troops and tended farming, and near and far praised him.

sentences.zh: 寶應元年，與諸節度同討襲史朝義，平之，加檢校工部尚書，賜實封，圖形淩煙閣。

translations.literal: In the first year of Baoying he joined the various military commissioners in jointly attacking Shi Chaoyi, pacified him, was additionally made acting minister of works, granted substantive enfeoffment, and his image was placed in the Lingyan Pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Baoying (762) he joined the various military commissioners in jointly attacking Shi Chaoyi, pacified him, was additionally made acting minister of works, granted substantive enfeoffment, and his image was placed in the Lingyan Pavilion.

sentences.zh: 以私艱去職。

translations.literal: Because of private bereavement he left office.
translations.idiomatic: Because of private bereavement he left office.

sentences.zh: 大歷十一年九月，起復檢校尚書右僕射、上柱國，封淮陽郡王。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the eleventh year of Dali he was recalled to service as acting right vice minister of works and pillar of state, enfeoffed Prince of Huaiyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the eleventh year of Dali (776) he was recalled to service as acting right vice minister of works and pillar of state, enfeoffed Prince of Huaiyang.

sentences.zh: 後漸縱恣，政事怠惰，尤崇奉釋教，且好畋遊，興功創寺宇，軍州苦之。

translations.literal: Later he gradually became unrestrained and dissolute, neglected government affairs and grew idle, especially revered and followed Buddhism, and also loved hunting; he raised works and founded temples, and army and prefectures suffered.
translations.idiomatic: Later he gradually became unrestrained and dissolute, neglected government affairs and grew idle, especially revered and followed Buddhism, and also loved hunting. He raised works and founded temples, and army and prefectures suffered.

sentences.zh: 永泰元年，因與巫者夜宿於城外，軍士乃閉之不納。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yongtai, because he lodged overnight with a shaman outside the city, the soldiers then closed the gates and would not admit him.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Yongtai (765), because he lodged overnight with a shaman outside the city, the soldiers then closed the gates and would not admit him.

sentences.zh: 希逸奔歸朝廷，拜檢校右僕射，久之，加知省事，遷司空。

translations.literal: Xiyi fled back to court and was appointed acting right vice minister of works; after long time he was additionally made director of ministry affairs and transferred to minister of works.
translations.idiomatic: Xiyi fled back to court and was appointed acting right vice minister of works. After a long time he was additionally made director of ministry affairs and transferred to minister of works.

sentences.zh: 詔出而卒，廢朝三日，贈太保。

translations.literal: An edict went out and he died; court was suspended for three days and he was posthumously enfeoffed grand protector.
translations.idiomatic: An edict went out and he died. Court was suspended for three days and he was posthumously enfeoffed grand protector.

sentences.zh: 李正己，高麗人也。

translations.literal: Li Zhengji was a man of Goguryeo.
translations.idiomatic: Li Zhengji was a man of Goguryeo.

sentences.zh: 本名懷玉，生於平盧。

translations.literal: His original name was Huaiyu; he was born in Pinglu.
translations.idiomatic: His original name was Huaiyu; he was born in Pinglu.

sentences.zh: 乾元元年，平盧節度使王玄誌卒，會有敕遣使來存問，懷玉恐玄誌子為節度，遂殺之，與軍人共推立侯希逸為軍帥。

translations.literal: In the first year of Qianyuan, when Pinglu military commissioner Wang Xuanzhi died, it happened that an edict-dispatching envoy came to inquire after him; Huaiyu feared Xuanzhi's son would become military commissioner, and therefore killed him, and with the soldiers together pushed and established Hou Xiyi as army commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Qianyuan (758), when Pinglu military commissioner Wang Xuanzhi died, it happened that an edict-dispatching envoy came to inquire after him. Huaiyu feared Xuanzhi's son would become military commissioner and therefore killed him, and with the soldiers together pushed and established Hou Xiyi as army commander.

sentences.zh: 希逸母即懷玉姑也。

translations.literal: Xiyi's mother was Huaiyu's paternal aunt.
translations.idiomatic: Xiyi's mother was Huaiyu's paternal aunt.

sentences.zh: 後與希逸同至青州，累至折沖將軍，驍健有勇力。

translations.literal: Later he went with Xiyi to Qing Prefecture, and was repeatedly promoted to garrison general, fierce and healthy with courage and strength.
translations.idiomatic: Later he went with Xiyi to Qing Prefecture and was repeatedly promoted to garrison general, fierce and healthy with courage and strength.

sentences.zh: 寶應中，眾軍討史朝義，至鄭州。

translations.literal: In the Baoying era the massed armies attacked Shi Chaoyi and reached Zheng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the Baoying era the massed armies attacked Shi Chaoyi and reached Zheng Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 回紇方強暴恣橫，諸節度皆下之，正己時為軍候，獨欲以氣吞之。

translations.literal: The Uighurs were then strong, violent, and overbearing; the various military commissioners all submitted to them; Zhengji at that time was army inspector and alone wished to swallow them by spirit.
translations.idiomatic: The Uighurs were then strong, violent, and overbearing; the various military commissioners all submitted to them. Zhengji at that time was army inspector and alone wished to swallow them by spirit.

sentences.zh: 因與其角逐，眾軍聚觀，約曰：「後者批之。」

translations.literal: Therefore he wrestled with them; the massed armies gathered to watch, and they agreed, saying: "Whoever is behind gets flogged."
translations.idiomatic: Therefore he wrestled with them. The massed armies gathered to watch, and they agreed, saying: "Whoever is behind gets flogged."

sentences.zh: 既逐而先，正己擒其領而批其背，回紇尿液俱下，眾軍呼笑，虜慚，由是不敢為暴。

translations.literal: Having chased and arrived first, Zhengji seized his collar and flogged his back; the Uighur urinated in full flow, the massed armies shouted and laughed, the barbarians were ashamed, and from this dared not act violently.
translations.idiomatic: Having chased and arrived first, Zhengji seized his collar and flogged his back. The Uighur urinated in full flow, the massed armies shouted and laughed, the barbarians were ashamed, and from this dared not act violently.

sentences.zh: 節度使侯希逸即其外兄也，用為兵馬使。
