translations.literal: Military commissioner Hou Xiyi was his maternal cousin and used him as army-and-horse commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Military commissioner Hou Xiyi was his maternal cousin and used him as army-and-horse commissioner.

sentences.zh: 正己沈毅得眾心，希逸因事解其職，軍中皆言其非罪，不當廢。

translations.literal: Zhengji was deep and resolute and won the hearts of the masses; Xiyi on account of affairs dismissed him from office, and the soldiers in the army all said it was not a crime and should not be dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengji was deep and resolute and won the hearts of the masses. Xiyi on account of affairs dismissed him from office, and the soldiers in the army all said it was not a crime and should not be dismissed.

sentences.zh: 會軍人逐希逸，希逸奔走，遂立正己為帥，朝廷因授平盧淄青節度觀察使、海運押新羅渤海兩蕃使、檢校工部尚書、兼御史大夫、青州刺史，賜今名。

translations.literal: It happened that the soldiers drove out Xiyi; Xiyi fled in haste, and they then established Zhengji as commander; the court therefore appointed him military commissioner and surveillance commissioner of Pinglu and Zi and Qing, sea-transport commissioner for the two foreign peoples of Silla and Bohai, acting minister of works, concurrent grand censor, and prefect of Qing Prefecture, and granted the present name.
translations.idiomatic: It happened that the soldiers drove out Xiyi. Xiyi fled in haste, and they then established Zhengji as commander. The court therefore appointed him military commissioner and surveillance commissioner of Pinglu and Zi and Qing, sea-transport commissioner for Silla and Bohai, acting minister of works, concurrent grand censor, and prefect of Qing Prefecture, and granted the present name.

sentences.zh: 尋加檢校尚書右僕射，封饒陽郡王。

translations.literal: Soon he was additionally made acting right vice minister of works and enfeoffed Prince of Raoyang.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was additionally made acting right vice minister of works and enfeoffed Prince of Raoyang.

sentences.zh: 大歷十一年十月，檢校司空、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the eleventh year of Dali he was made acting minister of works and associate of the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the eleventh year of Dali (776) he was made acting minister of works and associate of the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 十三年，請入屬籍，從之。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he requested entry into the imperial clan register; permission was granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year he requested entry into the imperial clan register; permission was granted.

sentences.zh: 為政嚴酷，所在不敢偶語。

translations.literal: His governance was stern and cruel; wherever he was, people dared not speak even in pairs.
translations.idiomatic: His governance was stern and cruel; wherever he was, people dared not speak even in pairs.

sentences.zh: 初有淄、青、齊、海、登、萊、沂、蜜、德、棣等州之地，與田承嗣、令狐彰、薛嵩、李寶臣、梁崇義更相影響。

translations.literal: At first he had the lands of Zi, Qing, Qi, Hai, Deng, Lai, Yi, Mi, De, and Di prefectures, and with Tian Chengsi, Ling Huzhang, Xue Song, Li Baochen, and Liang Chongyi mutually influenced one another.
translations.idiomatic: At first he had the lands of Zi, Qing, Qi, Hai, Deng, Lai, Yi, Mi, De, and Di prefectures, and with Tian Chengsi, Ling Huzhang, Xue Song, Li Baochen, and Liang Chongyi mutually influenced one another.

sentences.zh: 大歷中，薛嵩死，及李靈曜之亂，諸道共攻其地，得者為己邑，正己復得曹、濮、徐、兗、鄆，共十有五州，內視同列，貨市渤海名馬，歲歲不絕。

translations.literal: In the Dali era Xue Song died, and at the disorder of Li Lingyao the various circuits jointly attacked his lands; what was obtained became one's own territory; Zhengji again obtained Cao, Pu, Xu, Yan, and Yun—altogether fifteen prefectures—and inwardly viewed himself as equal to his peers, traded for famous horses of Bohai, year after year without break.
translations.idiomatic: In the Dali era Xue Song died, and at the disorder of Li Lingyao the various circuits jointly attacked his lands. What was obtained became one's own territory. Zhengji again obtained Cao, Pu, Xu, Yan, and Yun—altogether fifteen prefectures—and inwardly viewed himself as equal to his peers, trading for famous horses of Bohai year after year without break.

sentences.zh: 法令齊一，賦稅均輕，最稱強大。

translations.literal: Laws and orders were uniform, taxes light and even—the most called powerful and great.
translations.idiomatic: Laws and orders were uniform, taxes light and even—the most called powerful and great.

sentences.zh: 嘗攻田承嗣，威震鄰辭。

translations.literal: He once attacked Tian Chengsi and his prestige shook neighboring circuits.
translations.idiomatic: He once attacked Tian Chengsi and his prestige shook neighboring circuits.

sentences.zh: 歷檢校司空、左僕射、兼御史大夫，加平章事、太子太保、司徒。

translations.literal: He passed through acting minister of works, left vice minister of works, and concurrent grand censor, and was added associate of the Secretariat and Chancellery, heir apparent's grand protector, and minister of education.
translations.idiomatic: He passed through acting minister of works, left vice minister of works, and concurrent grand censor, and was added associate of the Secretariat and Chancellery, heir apparent's grand protector, and minister of education.

sentences.zh: 後自青州徙居鄆州，使子納及腹心之將分理其地。

translations.literal: Later he moved from Qing Prefecture to reside at Yun Prefecture and sent his son Na and trusted generals to separately administer the lands.
translations.idiomatic: Later he moved from Qing Prefecture to reside at Yun Prefecture and sent his son Na and trusted generals to separately administer the lands.

sentences.zh: 建中後，畏懼朝廷，多不自安。

translations.literal: After Jianzhong he feared the court and was mostly not at ease.
translations.idiomatic: After Jianzhong he feared the court and was mostly not at ease.

sentences.zh: 聞將築汴州，乃移兵屯濟陰，晝夜教習為備。

translations.literal: Hearing that Bian Prefecture was about to be fortified, he moved troops to garrison Jiyin and day and night drilled and practiced in preparation.
translations.idiomatic: Hearing that Bian Prefecture was about to be fortified, he moved troops to garrison Jiyin and day and night drilled and practiced in preparation.

sentences.zh: 河南騷然，天下為憂，羽檄馳走，征兵以益備。

translations.literal: Henan was disturbed; the realm was worried; urgent dispatches ran; troops were levied to increase preparations.
translations.idiomatic: Henan was disturbed; the realm was worried; urgent dispatches ran; troops were levied to increase preparations.

sentences.zh: 又於徐州增兵，以扼江淮，於是運輸為之改道。

translations.literal: Again at Xu Prefecture he increased troops to choke the Yangzi and Huai, and therefore transport was changed in route.
translations.idiomatic: Again at Xu Prefecture he increased troops to choke the Yangzi and Huai, and therefore transport was changed in route.

sentences.zh: 未幾，發疽卒，時年四十九。

translations.literal: Before long an abscess broke out and he died, at age forty-nine.
translations.idiomatic: Before long an abscess broke out and he died, at age forty-nine.

sentences.zh: 子納擅總兵政，秘之數月，乃發喪。

translations.literal: His son Na usurped overall military government, kept it secret for several months, and then announced the mourning.
translations.idiomatic: His son Na usurped overall military government, kept it secret for several months, and then announced the mourning.

sentences.zh: 納阻兵，興元元年四月，歸順，方贈正己太尉。

translations.literal: Na obstructed troops; in the fourth month of the first year of Xingyuan he returned to allegiance, and only then was Zhengji posthumously enfeoffed grand commandant.
translations.idiomatic: Na obstructed troops. In the fourth month of the first year of Xingyuan (784) he returned to allegiance, and only then was Zhengji posthumously enfeoffed grand commandant.

sentences.zh: 納少時，正己遣將兵備秋，代宗召見，嘉之，自奉禮郎超拜殿中丞、兼侍御史，賜紫金魚袋。

translations.literal: When young, Zhengji dispatched him to command troops for autumn defense; Daizong summoned him to audience, praised him, and from ceremonial usher super-promoted him to palace aide and concurrent attendant censor, bestowing the gold and purple fish bag.
translations.idiomatic: When young, Zhengji dispatched him to command troops for autumn defense. Daizong summoned him to audience, praised him, and from ceremonial usher super-promoted him to palace aide and concurrent attendant censor, bestowing the gold and purple fish bag.

sentences.zh: 歷檢校倉部郎中，兼總父兵，奏署淄州刺史。

translations.literal: He passed through acting director of the Bureau of Granaries and concurrently commanded his father's troops; he memorialized and appointed acting prefect of Zi Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He passed through acting director of the Bureau of Granaries and concurrently commanded his father's troops. He memorialized and appointed acting prefect of Zi Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 正己將兵擊田承嗣，奏署節度觀察留後。

translations.literal: When Zhengji led troops to attack Tian Chengsi he memorialized and appointed acting military commissioner and surveillance commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhengji led troops to attack Tian Chengsi he memorialized and appointed acting military commissioner and surveillance commissioner.

sentences.zh: 尋遷青州刺史，又奏署行軍司馬，兼曹州刺史、曹濮徐兗沂海留後，又加御史大夫。

translations.literal: Soon he was transferred to prefect of Qing Prefecture, again memorialized and appointed acting army-and-horse commissioner, concurrently prefect of Cao Prefecture and acting commissioner of Cao, Pu, Xu, Yan, Yi, and Hai, and again added grand censor.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was transferred to prefect of Qing Prefecture, again memorialized and appointed acting army-and-horse commissioner, concurrently prefect of Cao Prefecture and acting commissioner of Cao, Pu, Xu, Yan, Yi, and Hai, and again added grand censor.

sentences.zh: 建中初，正己、田悅、梁崇義、張惟嶽皆反。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Jianzhong, Zhengji, Tian Yue, Liang Chongyi, and Zhang Weiyue all rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Jianzhong, Zhengji, Tian Yue, Liang Chongyi, and Zhang Weiyue all rebelled.

sentences.zh: 二年，正己卒，納秘喪，統父眾，仍復為亂。

translations.literal: In the second year Zhengji died; Na kept the mourning secret, commanded his father's masses, and again rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year Zhengji died. Na kept the mourning secret, commanded his father's masses, and again rebelled.

sentences.zh: 比會悅於濮陽，遣大將衛俊將兵一千救悅，為河東節度使馬燧敗於洹水，殺傷殆盡。

translations.literal: About to meet Yue at Puyang, he dispatched great general Wei Jun to lead one thousand troops to rescue Yue; he was defeated by Hedong military commissioner Ma Sui at Huanshui, and casualties were nearly complete.
translations.idiomatic: About to meet Yue at Puyang, he dispatched great general Wei Jun to lead one thousand troops to rescue Yue. He was defeated by Hedong military commissioner Ma Sui at Huanshui, and casualties were nearly complete.

sentences.zh: 詔諸軍誅之，納從叔父洧以徐州，李士真以德州，及棣州李長卿，皆以州歸順。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the various armies to punish him; Na's uncle Wei gave up Xu Prefecture, Li Shizhen gave up De Prefecture, and Di Prefecture's Li Changqing all gave up their prefectures to return to allegiance.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the various armies to punish him. Na's uncle Wei gave up Xu Prefecture, Li Shizhen gave up De Prefecture, and Di Prefecture's Li Changqing all gave up their prefectures to return to allegiance.

sentences.zh: 納以彭城險厄，又怒洧背宗，乃悉兵圍之。

translations.literal: Na, because Pengcheng was strategically narrow and also angry that Wei betrayed the clan, then mustered all troops and besieged it.
translations.idiomatic: Na, because Pengcheng was strategically narrow and also angry that Wei betrayed the clan, then mustered all troops and besieged it.

sentences.zh: 詔宣武軍節度劉洽與諸軍救之，大敗納兵於城下。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Xuanwu Army military commissioner Liu Xia and the various armies to rescue it and greatly defeated Na's troops below the city.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Xuanwu Army military commissioner Liu Xia and the various armies to rescue it and greatly defeated Na's troops below the city.

sentences.zh: 後將兵於濮陽，洽攻破其城外。

translations.literal: Later he led troops at Puyang; Xia broke through outside his city.
translations.idiomatic: Later he led troops at Puyang. Xia broke through outside his city.

sentences.zh: 納自城上見洽，涕泣悔罪，遣判官房說以其弟經、男成務朝京師，請因洽從順。

translations.literal: Na from atop the city saw Xia, wept tears and repented guilt, and dispatched aide Fang Shuo to send his younger brother Jing and son Chengwu to court at the capital, requesting through Xia to follow allegiance.
translations.idiomatic: Na from atop the city saw Xia, wept tears and repented guilt, and dispatched aide Fang Shuo to send his younger brother Jing and son Chengwu to court at the capital, requesting through Xia to follow allegiance.

sentences.zh: 會中使宋鳳朝見之，謂納計蹙，欲誅破之以為己功，奏請無舍，上乃械說等系禁中。

translations.literal: It happened that the palace envoy Song Fengchao saw them and held that Na's plan was cornered, wishing to punish and break them to make merit for himself; he memorialized requesting no sparing; the emperor then shackled Shuo and the others and imprisoned them in the palace.
translations.idiomatic: It happened that the palace envoy Song Fengchao saw them and held that Na's plan was cornered, wishing to punish and break them to make merit for himself. He memorialized requesting no sparing; the emperor then shackled Shuo and the others and imprisoned them in the palace.

sentences.zh: 納遂歸鄆州，復與李希烈、硃滔、王武俊、田悅合謀皆反，偽稱齊王，建置百官。

translations.literal: Na then returned to Yun Prefecture, again joined Li Xilie, Zhu Tao, Wang Wujun, and Tian Yue in conspiracy all to rebel, falsely styled himself Prince of Qi, and established the hundred officials.
translations.idiomatic: Na then returned to Yun Prefecture, again joined Li Xilie, Zhu Tao, Wang Wujun, and Tian Yue in conspiracy all to rebel, falsely styled himself Prince of Qi, and established the hundred officials.

sentences.zh: 及興元之降罪己詔，納乃效順，詔加檢校工部尚書、平盧軍節度、淄青等州觀察使。

translations.literal: At the Xingyuan edict blaming self, Na then imitated allegiance; an edict additionally made him acting minister of works, Pinglu Army military commissioner, and surveillance commissioner of Zi, Qing, and other prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: At the Xingyuan edict blaming self, Na then imitated allegiance. An edict additionally made him acting minister of works, Pinglu Army military commissioner, and surveillance commissioner of Zi, Qing, and other prefectures.

sentences.zh: 無幾，檢校右僕射、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Before long he was made acting right vice minister of works and associate of the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was made acting right vice minister of works and associate of the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 時希烈圍陳州，納遣兵與諸軍奮擊，大破之，因解圍。

translations.literal: At that time Xilie besieged Chen Prefecture; Na dispatched troops to join the various armies in fierce attack and greatly defeated them, thereby lifting the siege.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Xilie besieged Chen Prefecture. Na dispatched troops to join the various armies in fierce attack and greatly defeated them, thereby lifting the siege.

sentences.zh: 加檢校司空，封五百戶。

translations.literal: He was additionally made acting minister of works and enfeoffed five hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: He was additionally made acting minister of works and enfeoffed five hundred households.

sentences.zh: 貞元初，升鄆州為大都督府，改授長史。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Zhenyuan, Yun Prefecture was elevated to metropolitan prefecture and he was changed and appointed chief administrator.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Zhenyuan, Yun Prefecture was elevated to metropolitan prefecture and he was changed and appointed chief administrator.

sentences.zh: 年三十四，薨於位，廢朝三日，贈賻有差。

translations.literal: At age thirty-four he died in office; court was suspended for three days and funeral gifts were granted in differing measure.
translations.idiomatic: At age thirty-four he died in office. Court was suspended for three days and funeral gifts were granted in differing measure.

sentences.zh: 子師古，累奏至青州刺史。

translations.literal: His son Shigu repeatedly memorialized up to prefect of Qing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: His son Shigu repeatedly memorialized up to prefect of Qing Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 貞元八年，納死，軍中以師古代其位而上請，朝廷因而授之。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Zhenyuan Na died; the army used Shigu to replace his position and submitted request above; the court therefore appointed him.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year of Zhenyuan (792) Na died. The army used Shigu to replace his position and submitted request above; the court therefore appointed him.

sentences.zh: 起復右金吾大將軍同正、平盧及青淄齊節度營田觀察、海運陸運押新羅渤海兩蕃使。

translations.literal: Recalled to service as right Golden Crow grand general of equal rank, Pinglu and Qing, Zi, and Qi military commission camp-field surveillance, and sea and land transport commissioner for Silla and Bohai.
translations.idiomatic: Recalled to service as right Golden Crow grand general of equal rank, Pinglu and Qing, Zi, and Qi military commission camp-field surveillance, and sea and land transport commissioner for Silla and Bohai.

sentences.zh: 成德軍節度王武俊率師次於德、棣二州，將取蛤𧊱及三汊城。

translations.literal: Chengde Army military commissioner Wang Wujun led troops stationed at De and Di prefectures, intending to take Ge and Sancha city.
translations.idiomatic: Chengde Army military commissioner Wang Wujun led troops stationed at De and Di prefectures, intending to take Ge and Sancha city.

sentences.zh: 棣州之鹽池與蛤𧊱歲出鹽數十萬斛，棣州之隸淄青也，其刺史李長卿以城入硃滔，而蛤𧊱為納所據，因城而戍之，以專鹽利。

translations.literal: Di Prefecture's salt ponds and Ge yearly produced several hundred thousand hu of salt; when Di Prefecture belonged to Zi and Qing, its prefect Li Changqing gave the city to Zhu Tao, and Ge was held by Na and therefore fortified and garrisoned it to monopolize salt profit.
translations.idiomatic: Di Prefecture's salt ponds and Ge yearly produced several hundred thousand hu of salt. When Di Prefecture belonged to Zi and Qing, its prefect Li Changqing gave the city to Zhu Tao, and Ge was held by Na and therefore fortified and garrisoned it to monopolize salt profit.

sentences.zh: 其後武俊以敗硃滔功，以德、棣二州隸之，蛤𧊱猶為納戍。

translations.literal: Later Wujun, for merit in defeating Zhu Tao, had De and Di prefectures placed under him; Ge was still garrisoned by Na.
translations.idiomatic: Later Wujun, for merit in defeating Zhu Tao, had De and Di prefectures placed under him. Ge was still garrisoned by Na.

sentences.zh: 納初於德州南跨河而城以守之，謂之三汊，交田緒以通魏博路，而侵掠德州，為武俊患。

translations.literal: At first Na south of De Prefecture crossed the river and fortified to defend it, calling it Sancha, joining Tian Xu to open the Weibo road, and invading and plundering De Prefecture, becoming Wujun's affliction.
translations.idiomatic: At first Na south of De Prefecture crossed the river and fortified to defend it, calling it Sancha, joining Tian Xu to open the Weibo road, and invading and plundering De Prefecture, becoming Wujun's affliction.

sentences.zh: 及納卒，師古繼之。

translations.literal: When Na died, Shigu succeeded him.
translations.idiomatic: When Na died, Shigu succeeded him.

sentences.zh: 武俊以其年弱初立，舊將多死，心頗易之，乃率眾兵以取蛤𧊱、三汊為名，其實欲窺納之境。

translations.literal: Wujun, because he was young and newly established and many old generals had died, in his heart somewhat held him easy, and therefore led massed troops under the name of taking Ge and Sancha, in truth wishing to spy on Na's territory.
translations.idiomatic: Wujun, because he was young and newly established and many old generals had died, in his heart somewhat held him easy, and therefore led massed troops under the name of taking Ge and Sancha, in truth wishing to spy on Na's territory.

sentences.zh: 師古令棣州降將趙鎬拒之。

translations.literal: Shigu ordered Di Prefecture's surrendering general Zhao Hao to resist him.
translations.idiomatic: Shigu ordered Di Prefecture's surrendering general Zhao Hao to resist him.

sentences.zh: 武俊令其子士清將兵先濟於滴河，會士清營中火起，軍驚，惡之，未進。

translations.literal: Wujun ordered his son Shiqing to lead troops first to cross at Dihé; it happened that fire arose in Shiqing's camp, the army was alarmed, considered it ill, and did not advance.
translations.idiomatic: Wujun ordered his son Shiqing to lead troops first to cross at Dihé. It happened that fire arose in Shiqing's camp, the army was alarmed, considered it ill, and did not advance.

sentences.zh: 德宗遣使諭旨，武俊即罷還。

translations.literal: Emperor Dezong dispatched an envoy to proclaim the intent; Wujun then ceased and returned.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Dezong dispatched an envoy to proclaim the intent; Wujun then ceased and returned.

sentences.zh: 師古毀三汊口城，從詔旨。

translations.literal: Shigu destroyed the Sancha mouth fortification, following the edict intent.
translations.idiomatic: Shigu destroyed the Sancha mouth fortification, following the edict intent.

sentences.zh: 師古雖外奉朝命，而嘗畜侵軼之謀，招集亡命，必厚養之，其得罪於朝而逃詣師古者，因即用之。

translations.literal: Although Shigu outwardly followed court orders, he often harbored plans of invasion and encroachment, gathered fugitives, and necessarily nourished them generously; those who offended the court and fled to Shigu were at once employed.
translations.idiomatic: Although Shigu outwardly followed court orders, he often harbored plans of invasion and encroachment, gathered fugitives, and necessarily nourished them generously. Those who offended the court and fled to Shigu were at once employed.

sentences.zh: 其有任使於外者，皆留其妻子，或謀歸款於朝，事泄，族其家，眾畏死而不敢異圖。

translations.literal: Those with duties outside all had wives and children detained; some plotted to return allegiance to the court, the matter leaked, and the clan was destroyed— the masses feared death and dared not harbor different plans.
translations.idiomatic: Those with duties outside all had wives and children detained. Some plotted to return allegiance to the court; the matter leaked and the clan was destroyed. The masses feared death and dared not harbor different plans.

sentences.zh: 貞元十年五月，師古服闋，加檢校禮部尚書。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the tenth year of Zhenyuan, when Shigu's mourning was completed, he was additionally made acting minister of rites.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the tenth year of Zhenyuan (794), when Shigu's mourning was completed, he was additionally made acting minister of rites.

sentences.zh: 十二年正月，檢校尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: In the first month of the twelfth year he was made acting right vice minister of works.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the twelfth year he was made acting right vice minister of works.

sentences.zh: 十一月，師古丁母憂，起復左金吾上將軍同正。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month Shigu entered mourning for his mother and was recalled to service as left Golden Crow upper general of equal rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Shigu entered mourning for his mother and was recalled to service as left Golden Crow upper general of equal rank.

sentences.zh: 十五年正月，師古、杜佑、李欒妾媵並為國夫人。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fifteenth year Shigu, Du You, and Li Luan's concubines were all made ladies of the state.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the fifteenth year Shigu, Du You, and Li Luan's concubines were all made ladies of the state.

sentences.zh: 十六年六月，與淮南節度使杜佑同制加中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the sixteenth year he and Huainan military commissioner Du You were jointly made associates of the Secretariat and Chancellery by the same order.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the sixteenth year he and Huainan military commissioner Du You were jointly made associates of the Secretariat and Chancellery by the same order.

sentences.zh: 及德宗遺詔下，告哀使未至，義成軍節度使李元素以與師古鄰道，錄遺詔報師古，以示無外。

translations.literal: When Dezong's testamentary edict was issued, before the mourning-announcement envoy arrived, Yicheng Army military commissioner Li Yuansu, because he was neighboring circuit to Shigu, copied the testamentary edict and reported to Shigu to show there was no exclusion.
translations.idiomatic: When Dezong's testamentary edict was issued, before the mourning-announcement envoy arrived, Yicheng Army military commissioner Li Yuansu, because he was neighboring circuit to Shigu, copied the testamentary edict and reported to Shigu to show there was no exclusion.

sentences.zh: 師古遂集將士，引元素使者謂曰：「師古近得邸吏狀，具承聖躬萬福。

translations.literal: Shigu then gathered officers and soldiers, brought in Yuansu's envoy, and said to them: "Shigu recently received a courier-clerk's report fully stating that the sacred person enjoys myriad blessings.
translations.idiomatic: Shigu then gathered officers and soldiers, brought in Yuansu's envoy, and said to them: "Shigu recently received a courier-clerk's report fully stating that the sacred person enjoys myriad blessings.

sentences.zh: 李元素豈欲反，乃忽偽錄遺詔以寄。

translations.literal: Li Yuansu—does he wish to rebel? He suddenly falsely copied a testamentary edict and sent it.
translations.idiomatic: Li Yuansu—does he wish to rebel? He suddenly falsely copied a testamentary edict and sent it.

sentences.zh: 師古三代受國恩，位兼將相，見賊不可以不討。」

translations.literal: Shigu for three generations received national favor, position combining general and minister—seeing rebels one cannot fail to punish."
translations.idiomatic: Shigu for three generations received national favor, position combining general and minister—seeing rebels one cannot fail to punish."

sentences.zh: 遂杖元素使者，遽出後以討元素為名，冀因國喪以侵州縣。

translations.literal: He then flogged Yuansu's envoy, swiftly went out afterward under the name of punishing Yuansu, hoping by the national mourning to invade prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: He then flogged Yuansu's envoy, swiftly went out afterward under the name of punishing Yuansu, hoping by the national mourning to invade prefectures and counties.

sentences.zh: 俄聞順宗即位，師古乃罷兵，

translations.literal: Soon hearing that Shunzong ascended the throne, Shigu then ceased troops,
translations.idiomatic: Soon hearing that Shunzong ascended the throne, Shigu then ceased troops.

sentences.zh: 後累官至檢校司徒、兼侍中。

translations.literal: later repeatedly reaching office as acting minister of education and concurrent palace attendant.
translations.idiomatic: Later he repeatedly reached office as acting minister of education and concurrent palace attendant.

sentences.zh: 卒贈太傅。

translations.literal: On death he was posthumously enfeoffed grand tutor.
translations.idiomatic: On death he was posthumously enfeoffed grand tutor.

sentences.zh: 師道，師古異母弟。

translations.literal: Shidao was Shigu's younger brother by a different mother.
translations.idiomatic: Shidao was Shigu's younger brother by a different mother.

sentences.zh: 其母張忠誌女。

translations.literal: His mother was Zhang Zhizhi's daughter.
translations.idiomatic: His mother was Zhang Zhizhi's daughter.

sentences.zh: 師道時知密州事，師古死，其奴不發喪，潛使迎師道於密而奉之。

translations.literal: Shidao at that time knew Mi Prefecture affairs; when Shigu died, his slave did not announce mourning and secretly sent to welcome Shidao from Mi to serve him.
translations.idiomatic: Shidao at that time knew Mi Prefecture affairs. When Shigu died, his slave did not announce mourning and secretly sent to welcome Shidao from Mi to serve him.

sentences.zh: 朝命久未至，師道謀於將吏，或欲加兵於四境，其判官高沐固止之。

translations.literal: Court orders long did not arrive; Shidao plotted with generals and officers; some wished to add troops to the four borders; his aide Gao Mu firmly stopped them.
translations.idiomatic: Court orders long did not arrive. Shidao plotted with generals and officers; some wished to add troops to the four borders. His aide Gao Mu firmly stopped them.

sentences.zh: 乃請進兩稅，守鹽法，申官員，遣判官崔承寵、孔目官林英相繼奏事。

translations.literal: He then requested to advance the two taxes, observe the salt law, declare official posts, and dispatch aides Cui Chengkong and clerk Lin Ying in succession to memorialize affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He then requested to advance the two taxes, observe the salt law, declare official posts, and dispatch aides Cui Chengkong and clerk Lin Ying in succession to memorialize affairs.

sentences.zh: 時杜黃裳作相，欲乘其未定也，以計分削之，憲宗以蜀川方擾，不能加兵於師道。

translations.literal: At that time Du Huangshang was chief minister and wished, while it was not yet settled, to divide and reduce it by plan; Xianzong, because Shu was then disturbed, could not add troops against Shidao.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Du Huangshang was chief minister and wished, while it was not yet settled, to divide and reduce it by plan. Xianzong, because Shu was then disturbed, could not add troops against Shidao.

sentences.zh: 元和元年七月，遂命建王審遙領節度，授師道檢校左散騎常侍、兼御史大夫，權知鄆州事，棄淄青節度留後。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the first year of Yuanhe an order was issued making Prince Shenyao lead the military commission and appointing Shidao acting left regular attendant of scattered cavalry and concurrent grand censor, acting commissioner of Yun Prefecture affairs, abandoning Zi and Qing military commission acting commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the first year of Yuanhe (806) an order was issued making Prince Shenyao lead the military commission and appointing Shidao acting left regular attendant of scattered cavalry and concurrent grand censor, acting commissioner of Yun Prefecture affairs, abandoning Zi and Qing military commission acting commissioner.

sentences.zh: 十月，加檢校工部尚書，兼鄆州大都督府長史，充平盧軍及淄青節度副大使，知節度事、管內支度營田觀察處置、陸運海運押新羅渤海兩蕃等使。

translations.literal: In the tenth month he was additionally made acting minister of works, chief administrator of Yun Metropolitan Prefecture, vice ambassador of the Pinglu Army and Zi and Qing military commission, knowing military commission affairs, managing within the circuit expenditure, camp-field, surveillance, and disposition, land and sea transport commissioner for Silla and Bohai, and the like.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month he was additionally made acting minister of works, chief administrator of Yun Metropolitan Prefecture, vice ambassador of the Pinglu Army and Zi and Qing military commission, knowing military commission affairs, managing within the circuit expenditure, camp-field, surveillance, and disposition, land and sea transport commissioner for Silla and Bohai, and the like.

sentences.zh: 自正己至師道，竊有鄆、曹等十二州，六十年矣。

translations.literal: From Zhengji to Shidao, they stealthily held Yun, Cao, and twelve other prefectures—for sixty years.
translations.idiomatic: From Zhengji to Shidao, they stealthily held Yun, Cao, and twelve other prefectures—for sixty years.

sentences.zh: 懼眾不附己，皆用嚴法制之。

translations.literal: Fearing the masses would not attach to them, all used stern law to control them.
translations.idiomatic: Fearing the masses would not attach to them, all used stern law to control them.

sentences.zh: 大將持兵鎮於外者，皆質其妻子；

translations.literal: Great generals holding troops garrisoned outside all had wives and children held as hostages;
translations.idiomatic: Great generals holding troops garrisoned outside all had wives and children held as hostages.

sentences.zh: 或謀歸款於朝，事泄，其家無少長皆殺之。

translations.literal: some plotted to return allegiance to the court; the matter leaked and their families, young and old, were all killed.
translations.idiomatic: Some plotted to return allegiance to the court; the matter leaked and their families, young and old, were all killed.

sentences.zh: 以故能劫其眾，父子兄弟相傳焉。

translations.literal: Therefore they could coerce their masses; father, son, and brothers passed it on in succession.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore they could coerce their masses; father, son, and brothers passed it on in succession.

sentences.zh: 五年七月，檢校尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the fifth year he was made acting right vice minister of works.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the fifth year he was made acting right vice minister of works.

sentences.zh: 十年，王師討蔡州，師道使賊燒河陰倉，斷建陵橋。

translations.literal: In the tenth year the imperial army attacked Cai Prefecture; Shidao made rebels burn Heyang granary and cut Jianling Bridge.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year the imperial army attacked Cai Prefecture. Shidao made rebels burn Heyang granary and cut Jianling Bridge.

sentences.zh: 初，師道置留邸於河南府，兵諜雜以往來，吏不敢辨。

translations.literal: At first Shidao established a lodging office in Henan Prefecture; military spies mixed in coming and going, and officials dared not distinguish.
translations.idiomatic: At first Shidao established a lodging office in Henan Prefecture. Military spies mixed in coming and going, and officials dared not distinguish.

sentences.zh: 因吳元濟北犯汝、鄭，郊畿多警，防禦兵盡戍伊闕，師道潛以兵數十百人內其邸，謀焚宮闕而肆殺掠。

translations.literal: Because Wu Yuanji north invaded Ru and Zheng, the capital region had many alarms and defense troops all garrisoned Yique; Shidao secretly sent several tens or hundreds of troops inside his lodging office, plotting to burn the palace halls and wildly kill and plunder.
translations.idiomatic: Because Wu Yuanji north invaded Ru and Zheng, the capital region had many alarms and defense troops all garrisoned Yique. Shidao secretly sent several tens or hundreds of troops inside his lodging office, plotting to burn the palace halls and wildly kill and plunder.

sentences.zh: 既烹牛饗眾矣，明日將出，會有小將楊進、李再興者詣留守呂元膺告變，元膺追伊闕兵圍之，半日不敢進攻。

translations.literal: Having already cooked beef to feast the masses, the next day about to go out, it happened that junior generals Yang Jin and Li Zaixing went to garrison commander Lu Yuanying to report the change; Yuanying pursued Yique troops to surround them; for half a day they dared not advance to attack.
translations.idiomatic: Having already cooked beef to feast the masses, the next day about to go out, it happened that junior generals Yang Jin and Li Zaixing went to garrison commander Lu Yuanying to report the change. Yuanying pursued Yique troops to surround them; for half a day they dared not advance to attack.

sentences.zh: 防禦判官王茂元殺一人而後進，或有毀其墉而入者。

translations.literal: Defense aide Wang Maoyuan killed one man and then advanced; some destroyed the wall and entered.
translations.idiomatic: Defense aide Wang Maoyuan killed one man and then advanced; some destroyed the wall and entered.

sentences.zh: 賊眾突出殺人，圍兵奔駭，賊得結伍中衢，內其妻子於囊橐中，以甲胄殿而行，防禦兵不敢追。

translations.literal: The rebel masses burst out killing people; the surrounding troops fled in alarm; the rebels were able to form ranks in the middle of the avenue, put wives and children inside sacks and bundles, marched with armor as rear guard, and defense troops dared not pursue.
translations.idiomatic: The rebel masses burst out killing people; the surrounding troops fled in alarm. The rebels were able to form ranks in the middle of the avenue, put wives and children inside sacks and bundles, marched with armor as rear guard, and defense troops dared not pursue.

sentences.zh: 賊出長夏門，轉掠郊墅，東濟伊水，入嵩山。

translations.literal: The rebels exited Changxia Gate, turned to plunder suburban villas, east crossed Yi River, and entered Mount Song.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels exited Changxia Gate, turned to plunder suburban villas, east crossed Yi River, and entered Mount Song.

sentences.zh: 元膺誡境上兵重購以捕之。

translations.literal: Yuanying warned frontier troops to heavily reward capture.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanying warned frontier troops to heavily reward capture.

sentences.zh: 數月，有山棚鬻鹿於市，賊遇而奪之，山棚走而征其黨，或引官軍共圍之谷中，盡獲之。

translations.literal: Several months later, mountain sheds sold deer in the market; rebels met and seized them; the mountain shed fled and summoned his party; some led government troops jointly to surround them in the valley and captured them all.
translations.idiomatic: Several months later, mountain sheds sold deer in the market. Rebels met and seized them; the mountain shed fled and summoned his party. Some led government troops jointly to surround them in the valley and captured them all.

sentences.zh: 窮理得其魁首，乃中嶽寺僧圓靜，年八十余，嘗為史思明將，偉悍過人。

translations.literal: Investigation to the end obtained the ringleader—Zhongyue Temple monk Yuanjing, more than eighty years old, who had once been Shi Siming's general, majestic and fierce surpassing others.
translations.idiomatic: Investigation to the end obtained the ringleader—Zhongyue Temple monk Yuanjing, more than eighty years old, who had once been Shi Siming's general, majestic and fierce surpassing others.

sentences.zh: 初執之，使巨力者奮錘，不能折脛。

translations.literal: At first when seized, they made men of great strength swing hammers; they could not break his shins.
translations.idiomatic: At first when seized, they made men of great strength swing hammers; they could not break his shins.

sentences.zh: 圓靜罵曰：「鼠子，折人腳猶不能，敢稱健兒乎！」

translations.literal: Yuanjing cursed, saying: "Rats! Breaking a man's foot you still cannot—dare you call yourselves stalwarts!"
translations.idiomatic: Yuanjing cursed, saying: "Rats! Breaking a man's foot you still cannot—dare you call yourselves stalwarts!"

sentences.zh: 乃自置其足教折之。

translations.literal: He then himself placed his foot and taught them to break it.
translations.idiomatic: He then himself placed his foot and taught them to break it.

sentences.zh: 臨刑，乃曰：「誤我事，不得使洛城流血。」

translations.literal: Facing execution he then said: "You have ruined my affair and cannot make Luoyang city flow with blood."
translations.idiomatic: Facing execution he then said: "You have ruined my affair and cannot make Luoyang city flow with blood."

sentences.zh: 死者凡數十人。

translations.literal: Those who died numbered several tens of men.
translations.idiomatic: Those who died numbered several tens of men.

sentences.zh: 留守禦將二人、都亭驛卒五人、甘水驛卒三人，皆潛受其職署，而為之耳目，自始謀及將敗，無知者。

translations.literal: Garrison defense generals two men, Duting Post runners five men, Ganshui Post runners three men—all secretly received his office appointments and served as his eyes and ears; from the first plot until near defeat, none knew.
translations.idiomatic: Garrison defense generals two men, Duting Post runners five men, Ganshui Post runners three men—all secretly received his office appointments and served as his eyes and ears. From the first plot until near defeat, none knew.

sentences.zh: 初，師道多買田於伊闕、陸渾之間，凡十所處，欲以舍山而衣食之。

translations.literal: At first Shidao bought much land between Yique and Luhun—altogether ten places—wishing to lodge mountain people and feed them.
translations.idiomatic: At first Shidao bought much land between Yique and Luhun—altogether ten places—wishing to lodge mountain people and feed them.

sentences.zh: 有訾嘉珍、門察者，潛部分之，以屬圓靜，以師道錢千萬偽理嵩山之佛光寺，期以嘉珍竊發時舉火於山中，集二縣山棚人作亂。

translations.literal: There were Zi Jiazhen and Men Cha who secretly divided it and assigned it to Yuanjing; with Shidao's money ten million they falsely managed Foguang Temple on Mount Song, planning that when Jiazhen secretly rose they would light fire in the mountains, gathering mountain-shed people of the two counties to make disorder.
translations.idiomatic: There were Zi Jiazhen and Men Cha who secretly divided it and assigned it to Yuanjing. With Shidao's money ten million they falsely managed Foguang Temple on Mount Song, planning that when Jiazhen secretly rose they would light fire in the mountains, gathering mountain-shed people of the two counties to make disorder.

sentences.zh: 及窮按之，嘉珍、門察，乃賊武元衡者，元膺具狀以聞。

translations.literal: When investigation reached the end, Jiazhen and Men Cha were the rebels who killed Wu Yuanheng; Yuanying fully stated the facts and reported above.
translations.idiomatic: When investigation reached the end, Jiazhen and Men Cha were the rebels who killed Wu Yuanheng. Yuanying fully stated the facts and reported above.

sentences.zh: 及誅吳元濟，師道恐懼，上表乞聽朝旨，請割三州並遣長子入侍宿衛，詔許之。

translations.literal: When Wu Yuanji was punished, Shidao feared and submitted a memorial begging to obey court intent, requesting to cede three prefectures and dispatch his eldest son to attend as palace guard; an edict granted permission.
translations.idiomatic: When Wu Yuanji was punished, Shidao feared and submitted a memorial begging to obey court intent, requesting to cede three prefectures and dispatch his eldest son to attend as palace guard. An edict granted permission.

sentences.zh: 師道識暗，政事皆決於群婢。

translations.literal: Shidao was dim in judgment; government affairs were all decided by the crowd of maidservants.
translations.idiomatic: Shidao was dim in judgment; government affairs were all decided by the crowd of maidservants.

sentences.zh: 婢有號蒲大姊、袁七娘者，為謀主，乃言曰：「自先司徒以來，有此十二州，奈何一日無苦而割之耶！

translations.literal: Maidservants styled Elder Sister Pu and Seventh Sister Yuan were chief plotters; they then spoke, saying: "Since the former minister of education, there have been these twelve prefectures—how can one in a single day without hardship cede them!
translations.idiomatic: Maidservants styled Elder Sister Pu and Seventh Sister Yuan were chief plotters. They then spoke, saying: "Since the former minister of education, there have been these twelve prefectures—how can one in a single day without hardship cede them!

sentences.zh: 今境內兵士數十萬人，不獻三州，不過發兵相加，可以力戰，戰不勝，乃議割地，未晚也。」

translations.literal: Now within the territory soldiers number several hundred thousand; not presenting three prefectures is only dispatching troops to oppose one another—one can fight by force; if fighting does not prevail, then discuss ceding land—not late."
translations.idiomatic: Now within the territory soldiers number several hundred thousand. Not presenting three prefectures is only dispatching troops to oppose one another—one can fight by force. If fighting does not prevail, then discuss ceding land—not late."

sentences.zh: 師道從之而止，表言軍情不葉，乃詔諸軍討伐。

translations.literal: Shidao followed them and stopped; the memorial said the army's sentiment would not consent, and therefore an edict ordered the various armies to punish.
translations.idiomatic: Shidao followed them and stopped. The memorial said the army's sentiment would not consent, and therefore an edict ordered the various armies to punish.

sentences.zh: 十年十二月，武寧軍節度使李願遣將王智興擊破師道之眾九千，斬首二千余級，獲牛馬四千，遂至平陰。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the tenth year, Wuning Army military commissioner Li Yuan dispatched general Wang Zhixing and defeated Shidao's masses nine thousand, beheaded more than two thousand, captured oxen and horses four thousand, and reached Pingyin.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the tenth year, Wuning Army military commissioner Li Yuan dispatched general Wang Zhixing and defeated Shidao's masses nine thousand, beheaded more than two thousand, captured oxen and horses four thousand, and reached Pingyin.

sentences.zh: 十一年十一月，加師道司空，仍遣給事中柳公綽往宣慰，且觀所為，欲寬容之。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the eleventh year Shidao was made minister of works and still dispatched supervisory attendant Liu Gongchuo to go comfort and reassure and observe his conduct, wishing to be lenient.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of the eleventh year Shidao was made minister of works and still dispatched supervisory attendant Liu Gongchuo to go comfort and reassure and observe his conduct, wishing to be lenient.

sentences.zh: 師道茍以遜順為辭，長惡不悛。

translations.literal: Shidao perfunctorily used yielding compliance as words and long hated without repenting.
translations.idiomatic: Shidao perfunctorily used yielding compliance as words and long hated without repenting.

sentences.zh: 十三年七月，滄州節度使鄭權破淄青賊於齊州福城縣，斬首五百余級。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the thirteenth year, Cang Prefecture military commissioner Zheng Quan defeated Zi and Qing rebels at Fucheng County of Qi Prefecture and beheaded more than five hundred.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the thirteenth year, Cang Prefecture military commissioner Zheng Quan defeated Zi and Qing rebels at Fucheng County of Qi Prefecture and beheaded more than five hundred.

sentences.zh: 十月，徐州節度使李愬、兵馬使李祐於兗州魚臺縣破賊三千余人。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, Xu Prefecture military commissioner Li Su and army-and-horse commissioner Li You at Yutai County of Yan Prefecture defeated rebels more than three thousand.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, Xu Prefecture military commissioner Li Su and army-and-horse commissioner Li You at Yutai County of Yan Prefecture defeated rebels more than three thousand.

sentences.zh: 魏博節度使田弘正率本軍自陽劉渡河，距鄆州九十里下營，再接戰，破賊三萬余眾，生擒三千人，收器械不可勝紀。

translations.literal: Weibo military commissioner Tian Hongzheng led his own army from Yangliu crossed the river, camped ninety li from Yun Prefecture, again joined battle, defeated rebels more than thirty thousand, captured alive three thousand, and collected weapons beyond reckoning.
translations.idiomatic: Weibo military commissioner Tian Hongzheng led his own army from Yangliu crossed the river, camped ninety li from Yun Prefecture, again joined battle, defeated rebels more than thirty thousand, captured alive three thousand, and collected weapons beyond reckoning.

sentences.zh: 陳許節度使李光顏於濮陽縣界破賊，收鬥門城、杜莊柵。

translations.literal: Chenxu military commissioner Li Guangyan at the border of Puyang County defeated rebels and recovered Doumen city and Duzhuang palisade.
translations.idiomatic: Chenxu military commissioner Li Guangyan at the border of Puyang County defeated rebels and recovered Doumen city and Duzhuang palisade.

sentences.zh: 田弘正復於故東阿縣界破賊五萬。

translations.literal: Tian Hongzheng again at the border of old Dong'e County defeated rebels fifty thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Tian Hongzheng again at the border of old Dong'e County defeated rebels fifty thousand.

sentences.zh: 諸軍四合，累下城柵。

translations.literal: The various armies joined from four sides and repeatedly took city palisades.
translations.idiomatic: The various armies joined from four sides and repeatedly took city palisades.

sentences.zh: 師道使劉悟將兵當魏博軍，既敗，數令促戰。

translations.literal: Shidao dispatched Liu Wu to lead troops to face the Weibo army; having been defeated, he repeatedly ordered urgent battle.
translations.idiomatic: Shidao dispatched Liu Wu to lead troops to face the Weibo army. Having been defeated, he repeatedly ordered urgent battle.

sentences.zh: 師未進，乃使奴召悟計事。

translations.literal: The army had not advanced; he then sent a slave to summon Wu to plan affairs.
translations.idiomatic: The army had not advanced; he then sent a slave to summon Wu to plan affairs.

sentences.zh: 悟知其來殺己，乃稱病不出，召將吏謀曰：「魏博兵強，乘勝出戰，必敗吾師，不出則死。

translations.literal: Wu knew he came to kill him and therefore feigned illness and did not go out; he summoned generals and officers and plotted, saying: "Weibo troops are strong; riding victory to go out to battle will necessarily defeat our army; not going out then is death.
translations.idiomatic: Wu knew he came to kill him and therefore feigned illness and did not go out. He summoned generals and officers and plotted, saying: "Weibo troops are strong. Riding victory to go out to battle will necessarily defeat our army. Not going out then is death.

sentences.zh: 今天子所誅，司空一人而已。

translations.literal: What the Son of Heaven punishes is only the minister of works alone.
translations.idiomatic: What the Son of Heaven punishes is only the minister of works alone.

sentences.zh: 悟與公等皆被驅逐就死地，何如轉禍為福，殺其來使，以兵趣鄆州，立大功以求富貴。」

translations.literal: Wu and you gentlemen are all driven and expelled to the place of death—how about turning calamity into blessing, killing the coming envoy, and with troops hasten to Yun Prefecture to establish great merit and seek wealth and honor?"
translations.idiomatic: Wu and you gentlemen are all driven and expelled to the place of death. How about turning calamity into blessing, killing the coming envoy, and with troops hasten to Yun Prefecture to establish great merit and seek wealth and honor?"

sentences.zh: 眾皆曰：「善。」

translations.literal: The masses all said: "Good."
translations.idiomatic: The masses all said: "Good."

sentences.zh: 乃迎其使而斬之，遂賚師道追牒，以兵趣鄆州。

translations.literal: He then welcomed the envoy and beheaded him and swiftly presented Shidao's pursuit order; with troops he hastened to Yun Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He then welcomed the envoy and beheaded him and swiftly presented Shidao's pursuit order. With troops he hastened to Yun Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 及夜，至門，示以師道追牒，乃得入。

translations.literal: At night reaching the gate, showing Shidao's pursuit order, he then was able to enter.
translations.idiomatic: At night reaching the gate, showing Shidao's pursuit order, he then was able to enter.

sentences.zh: 兵士繼進，至球場，因圍其內城，以火攻之，擒師道而斬其首，送於魏博軍，元和十四年二月也。

translations.literal: Soldiers continued advancing to the drill ground; therefore they surrounded the inner city, attacked with fire, captured Shidao and beheaded his head, and sent it to the Weibo army—in the second month of the fourteenth year of Yuanhe.
translations.idiomatic: Soldiers continued advancing to the drill ground. Therefore they surrounded the inner city, attacked with fire, captured Shidao and beheaded him, and sent his head to the Weibo army—in the second month of the fourteenth year of Yuanhe (819).

sentences.zh: 是月，弘正獻於京師，天子命左右軍如受馘儀，先獻於太廟效社，憲宗禦興安門受之，百僚稱賀。

translations.literal: That month Hongzheng presented it at the capital; the Son of Heaven ordered the left and right armies to receive it with the ritual of presenting captives, first presenting it at the Imperial Ancestral Temple and Altar of Soil; Xianzong attended at Xing'an Gate to receive it; the hundred officials congratulated.
translations.idiomatic: That month Hongzheng presented it at the capital. The Son of Heaven ordered the left and right armies to receive it with the ritual of presenting captives, first presenting it at the Imperial Ancestral Temple and Altar of Soil. Xianzong attended at Xing'an Gate to receive it; the hundred officials congratulated.

sentences.zh: 初，東軍諸道行營節度擒逆賊將夏侯澄等共四十七人，詔曰：「附麗兇黨，拒抗王師，國有常刑，悉合誅戮。

translations.literal: At first the eastern armies' various-circuit traveling-camp military commissioner captured rebel generals Xia Houcheng and forty-seven others together; an edict said: "Clinging to vicious partisans, resisting the imperial army—the state has constant punishment and all should be executed.
translations.idiomatic: At first the eastern armies' various-circuit traveling-camp military commissioner captured rebel generals Xia Houcheng and forty-seven others together. An edict said: "Clinging to vicious partisans, resisting the imperial army—the state has constant punishment and all should be executed.

sentences.zh: 朕以久居汙俗，皆被脅從，況討伐已來，時日不幾，縱懷轉禍之計，未有效款之由，情似可矜，朕不忍殺。

translations.literal: I, because long dwelling in defiled custom, all were coerced to follow; moreover since the punitive attack began, days and months are not many; even if harboring plans to turn calamity, there has been no cause of effective allegiance—the sentiment seems pitiable and I cannot bear to kill.
translations.idiomatic: I, because long dwelling in defiled custom, all were coerced to follow. Moreover since the punitive attack began, days and months are not many. Even if harboring plans to turn calamity, there has been no cause of effective allegiance—the sentiment seems pitiable and I cannot bear to kill.

sentences.zh: 況三軍百姓，孰非吾人，詔令頒行，罪止師道。

translations.literal: Moreover the three armies and common people—who are not my people? When the edict order is promulgated, guilt stops at Shidao.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover the three armies and common people—who are not my people? When the edict order is promulgated, guilt stops at Shidao.

sentences.zh: 方欲拯於塗炭，是用活其性命，誠為屈法，庶使知恩。

translations.literal: Just wishing to rescue from charcoal and wash, therefore preserving their lives—truly bending the law, hoping thereby to make them know favor.
translations.idiomatic: Just wishing to rescue from charcoal and wash, therefore preserving their lives—truly bending the law, hoping thereby to make them know favor.

sentences.zh: 並宜特從釋放，仍令卻遞送至魏博及義成行營，各委節度收管驅使。

translations.literal: All should be specially released and still ordered to return in succession to the Weibo and Yicheng traveling camps, each entrusted to the military commissioner to take charge and drive.
translations.idiomatic: All should be specially released and still ordered to return in succession to the Weibo and Yicheng traveling camps, each entrusted to the military commissioner to take charge and drive.

sentences.zh: 如父母血屬猶在賊中，或羸老疾病情切歸還者，仍量事優當放去，務備相全貸，何所疑留。」

translations.literal: If parents and blood kin are still among rebels, or weak, old, and ill with urgent wish to return—still measure affairs generously and appropriately release, striving to complete pardon and loan—why any doubt to detain?"
translations.idiomatic: If parents and blood kin are still among rebels, or weak, old, and ill with urgent wish to return—still measure affairs generously and appropriately release, striving to complete pardon and loan—why any doubt to detain?"

sentences.zh: 及澄等至行營，賊覘知傳告，叛徒皆感朝恩，由是劉悟得行其謀焉。

translations.literal: When Cheng and the others reached the traveling camp, rebels spying knew and transmitted report; rebel partisans were all moved by court favor—thereby Liu Wu was able to carry out his plan.
translations.idiomatic: When Cheng and the others reached the traveling camp, rebels spying knew and transmitted report. Rebel partisans were all moved by court favor—thereby Liu Wu was able to carry out his plan.

sentences.zh: 師道妻魏氏及小男並配掖庭。

translations.literal: Shidao's wife Lady Wei and young son were all assigned to the rear palace.
translations.idiomatic: Shidao's wife Lady Wei and young son were all assigned to the rear palace.

sentences.zh: 堂弟師賢、師智配流春州，侄弘巽配流雷州。

translations.literal: Cousins Shixian and Shizhi were banished to Chun Prefecture; nephew Hongxun was banished to Lei Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Cousins Shixian and Shizhi were banished to Chun Prefecture; nephew Hongxun was banished to Lei Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 詔分其十二州為三節度，俾馬總、薛平、王遂分鎮焉。

translations.literal: An edict divided their twelve prefectures into three military commissions, making Ma Zong, Xue Ping, and Wang Sui separately garrison them.
translations.idiomatic: An edict divided their twelve prefectures into three military commissions, making Ma Zong, Xue Ping, and Wang Sui separately garrison them.

sentences.zh: 仍命宰臣崔群撰碑以紀其績。

translations.literal: Still an order was issued for chief minister Cui Qun to compose a stele to record the achievement.
translations.idiomatic: Still an order was issued for chief minister Cui Qun to compose a stele to record the achievement.

sentences.zh: 國家自天寶末安祿山首亂兩河，至寶應元年王師平史朝義，其將薛嵩、李懷仙、田承嗣、李寶臣等受偽命分領州郡，朝廷厭兵，因仆固懷恩請，就加官爵。

translations.literal: The state from the end of Tianbao when An Lushan first disturbed the two rivers, to the first year of Baoying when the imperial army pacified Shi Chaoyi—his generals Xue Song, Li Huaixian, Tian Chengsi, Li Baochen, and the like received false appointments and separately led prefectures and counties; the court tired of warfare and because Pugu Huai'en requested it, then added offices and titles on the spot.
translations.idiomatic: The state from the end of Tianbao when An Lushan first disturbed the two rivers, to the first year of Baoying when the imperial army pacified Shi Chaoyi—his generals Xue Song, Li Huaixian, Tian Chengsi, Li Baochen, and the like received false appointments and separately led prefectures and counties. The court tired of warfare and because Pugu Huai'en requested it, then added offices and titles on the spot.

sentences.zh: 及侯希逸為軍人逐出，正己又據齊、魯之地，既而遞相膠固，聯結姻好，職貢不入，法令不加，率以為常。

translations.literal: When Hou Xiyi was driven out by soldiers and Zhengji again held Qi and Lu lands, they then in succession glued solid, joined marriage ties, tribute did not enter, laws and orders were not applied—all taken as constant.
translations.idiomatic: When Hou Xiyi was driven out by soldiers and Zhengji again held Qi and Lu lands, they then in succession glued solid, joined marriage ties, tribute did not enter, laws and orders were not applied—all taken as constant.

sentences.zh: 仍皆署其子為副大使，父死子立，則以三軍之請聞，亦有為大將所殺而自立者。

translations.literal: Still all appointed their sons as vice ambassadors; when the father died the son established, then with the three armies' request it was reported; there were also those established by themselves after great generals were killed.
translations.idiomatic: Still all appointed their sons as vice ambassadors. When the father died the son established, then with the three armies' request it was reported. There were also those established by themselves after great generals were killed.

sentences.zh: 自安、史以後，迄至於貞元，朝廷多務優容，每聞擅襲，因而授之，以故六十余年，兩河號為反側之俗。

translations.literal: From An and Shi afterward, reaching Zhenyuan, the court mostly pursued forbearance; each time hearing of usurped succession, they therefore appointed—thus for more than sixty years the two rivers were called a custom of rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: From An and Shi afterward, reaching Zhenyuan, the court mostly pursued forbearance. Each time hearing of usurped succession, they therefore appointed—thus for more than sixty years the two rivers were called a custom of rebellion.

sentences.zh: 憲宗知人善任，削平亂跡，兩河復為王土焉。

translations.literal: Xianzong knew men and employed them well, cut down and pacified disorderly traces, and the two rivers again became royal soil.
translations.idiomatic: Xianzong knew men and employed them well, cut down and pacified disorderly traces, and the two rivers again became royal soil.

sentences.zh: 師道妻魏氏，元和十五年出家為尼。

translations.literal: Shidao's wife Lady Wei, in the fifteenth year of Yuanhe left the world to become a nun.
translations.idiomatic: Shidao's wife Lady Wei, in the fifteenth year of Yuanhe left the world to become a nun.

sentences.zh: 洧，正己從父兄也。

translations.literal: Wei was Zhengji's cousin.
translations.idiomatic: Wei was Zhengji's cousin.

sentences.zh: 正己用為徐州刺史。

translations.literal: Zhengji used him as prefect of Xu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengji used him as prefect of Xu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 正己死，子納犯宋州，洧以其州歸順，加御史大夫，封潮陽郡王，食實封二百戶，充招諭使。

translations.literal: When Zhengji died, his son Na violated Song Prefecture; Wei with his prefecture returned to allegiance, was added grand censor, enfeoffed Prince of Chaoyang, granted substantive enfeoffment two hundred households, and made commissioner to summon and instruct.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhengji died, his son Na violated Song Prefecture. Wei with his prefecture returned to allegiance, was added grand censor, enfeoffed Prince of Chaoyang, granted substantive enfeoffment two hundred households, and made commissioner to summon and instruct.

sentences.zh: 初，洧遣攝巡官崔程奉表至京師，令口奏並白宰相：「徐州恐不能獨當賊，若得徐、海、沂三州節度都團練使，即必立功。

translations.literal: At first Wei dispatched acting patrol official Cui Cheng to present a memorial to the capital and ordered oral report and also inform the chief ministers: "Xu Prefecture fears it cannot alone withstand rebels; if obtaining military commission and defense commissioner of Xu, Hai, and Yi—three prefectures—then necessarily establishing merit.
translations.idiomatic: At first Wei dispatched acting patrol official Cui Cheng to present a memorial to the capital and ordered oral report and also inform the chief ministers: "Xu Prefecture fears it cannot alone withstand rebels. If obtaining military commission and defense commissioner of Xu, Hai, and Yi—three prefectures—then necessarily establishing merit.

sentences.zh: 況海、沂兩州，亦並為賊納所據，非國家州縣。

translations.literal: Moreover Hai and Yi two prefectures also are all held by rebel Na; they are not state prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover Hai and Yi two prefectures also are all held by rebel Na; they are not state prefectures and counties.

sentences.zh: 其刺史王涉、馬萬通等，洧並素與之約，若有詔命，冀必成功。」

translations.literal: Their prefects Wang She and Ma Wantong and the like—Wei all along made agreements with them; if there is an edict order, I hope necessarily success."
translations.idiomatic: Their prefects Wang She and Ma Wantong and the like—Wei all along made agreements with them. If there is an edict order, I hope necessarily success."

sentences.zh: 程乍自外到闕，以為宰相一也，乃先以其言白張鎰，鎰言於盧杞。

translations.literal: Cheng, suddenly from outside arriving at court, thought the chief ministers were one body and therefore first with his words informed Zhang Yi; Yi spoke to Lu Qi.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng, suddenly from outside arriving at court, thought the chief ministers were one body and therefore first with his words informed Zhang Yi. Yi spoke to Lu Qi.

sentences.zh: 杞怒程不先白己，故洧所請不行，杞妨公害私，皆此類也。

translations.literal: Qi was angry that Cheng did not first inform him; therefore Wei's request was not carried out—Qi obstructing public affairs for private ends were all this kind.
translations.idiomatic: Qi was angry that Cheng did not first inform him; therefore Wei's request was not carried out—Qi obstructing public affairs for private ends were all this kind.

sentences.zh: 及李納遣兵攻徐州，劉洽與諸將擊退之，賊勢未衰，始加洧徐、海、沂都團練觀察使，尋加密州。

translations.literal: When Li Na dispatched troops to attack Xu Prefecture, Liu Xia with the various generals repelled them; rebel momentum was not yet weakened and only then was Wei added Xu, Hai, and Yi defense and surveillance commissioner; soon Mi Prefecture was added.
translations.idiomatic: When Li Na dispatched troops to attack Xu Prefecture, Liu Xia with the various generals repelled them. Rebel momentum was not yet weakened and only then was Wei added Xu, Hai, and Yi defense and surveillance commissioner; soon Mi Prefecture was added.

sentences.zh: 時海、密州皆為賊所據，不受洧命。

translations.literal: At that time Hai and Mi prefectures were all held by rebels and did not accept Wei's orders.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Hai and Mi prefectures were all held by rebels and did not accept Wei's orders.

sentences.zh: 旋加洧檢校戶部尚書。

translations.literal: Soon Wei was additionally made acting minister of revenue.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Wei was additionally made acting minister of revenue.

sentences.zh: 未幾，疽發背，稍平，乃大具糜餅，飯僧於市，洧乘平肩輿自臨其場，市人歡呼，洧驚，疽潰於背而卒，贈左僕射。

translations.literal: Before long an abscess broke out on his back; when somewhat healed he greatly prepared gruel cakes and fed monks in the market; Wei riding a level shoulder carriage personally arrived at the place; market people shouted joy; Wei was startled; the abscess burst on his back and he died; he was posthumously enfeoffed left vice minister of works.
translations.idiomatic: Before long an abscess broke out on his back. When somewhat healed he greatly prepared gruel cakes and fed monks in the market. Wei riding a level shoulder carriage personally arrived at the place; market people shouted joy. Wei was startled; the abscess burst on his back and he died. He was posthumously enfeoffed left vice minister of works.

sentences.zh: 史臣曰：自安、史亂離，河朔割據，雖外尊朝旨，而內蓄奸謀。

translations.literal: The historian says: From An and Shi's disorder and separation, Hebei was carved up and held; although outwardly honoring court intent, inwardly they harbored treacherous plots.
translations.idiomatic: The historian says: From An and Shi's disorder and separation, Hebei was carved up and held. Although outwardly honoring court intent, inwardly they harbored treacherous plots.

sentences.zh: 薛嵩祖父，國之名將，及身濡足賊廷，既沐國恩，尚存家法，守土奉職，終身一心，果有令人，克全余慶。

translations.literal: Xue Song's grandfather and father were famous generals of the state; reaching himself he waded in the rebel court, yet bathed in national favor and still preserved family law, guarding soil and fulfilling duty, lifelong one heart—truly there was a worthy man who could complete remaining blessing.
translations.idiomatic: Xue Song's grandfather and father were famous generals of the state. Reaching himself he waded in the rebel court, yet bathed in national favor and still preserved family law, guarding soil and fulfilling duty with lifelong single-heartedness—truly there was a worthy man who could complete remaining blessing.

sentences.zh: 彰居喪循禮，有士子之風；

translations.literal: Zhang in mourning followed ritual and had the bearing of a scholar;
translations.idiomatic: Zhang in mourning followed ritual and had the bearing of a scholar.

sentences.zh: 馭眾權謀，著將軍之業。

translations.literal: controlling the masses with stratagem, he displayed a general's achievement.
translations.idiomatic: Controlling the masses with stratagem, he displayed a general's achievement.

sentences.zh: 中外善政，終始令名，成功不居，告老致仕，方之者鮮矣。

translations.literal: Within and without, good government from beginning to end fine name; not dwelling on success, reporting old age and retiring—those compared with him were few.
translations.idiomatic: Within and without, good government from beginning to end fine name; not dwelling on success, reporting old age and retiring—those compared with him were few.

sentences.zh: 背逆歸國，治兵牧民，上表推誠，舉賢代己，時稱能善始善終者也。

translations.literal: Turning from rebellion to return to the state, ordering troops and tending the people, submitting a memorial with sincerity, recommending the able to replace himself—of the time called able to begin and end well.
translations.idiomatic: Turning from rebellion to return to the state, ordering troops and tending the people, submitting a memorial with sincerity, recommending the able to replace himself—of the time called able to begin and end well.

sentences.zh: 建誌稟遺訓，克全令名，不能終保功業，惜哉！

translations.literal: Jian received the testamentary instruction and could complete fine name; unable to the end preserve achievement and enterprise—pity!
translations.idiomatic: Jian received the testamentary instruction and could complete fine name; unable to the end preserve achievement and enterprise—pity!

sentences.zh: 神功忠勇，竟著勛名；

translations.literal: Shengong loyal and brave, ultimately displaying merit and name;
translations.idiomatic: Shengong loyal and brave, ultimately displaying merit and name.

sentences.zh: 希逸荒狂，自失茅土。

translations.literal: Xiyi wild and mad, himself losing fief soil.
translations.idiomatic: Xiyi wild and mad, himself losing fief soil.

sentences.zh: 師道祖父弟兄，盜據青、鄆，得計則潛圖兇逆，失勢則偽奉朝旨，向背任情，數十年矣。

translations.literal: Shidao's grandfather, brothers, and brothers stealthily held Qing and Yun; when gaining advantage then secretly plotted fierce rebellion; when losing power then falsely followed court intent—facing and turning at will—for several tens of years.
translations.idiomatic: Shidao's grandfather, brothers, and brothers stealthily held Qing and Yun. When gaining advantage then secretly plotted fierce rebellion; when losing power then falsely followed court intent—facing and turning at will—for several tens of years.

sentences.zh: 或問曰：師古之前，三帥而不滅；

translations.literal: Someone asked: Before Shigu, three commanders yet not destroyed;
translations.idiomatic: Someone asked: Before Shigu, three commanders yet not destroyed;

sentences.zh: 師道繼立，數年而亡者，何哉？

translations.literal: Shidao succeeded and in several years perished—why?
translations.idiomatic: Shidao succeeded and in several years perished—why?

sentences.zh: 答曰：納與師古，自運奸謀，躬臨戎事；

translations.literal: The answer said: Na and Shigu themselves carried treacherous plots and personally faced military affairs;
translations.idiomatic: The answer said: Na and Shigu themselves carried treacherous plots and personally faced military affairs;

sentences.zh: 朝廷任盧杞，以私妨公，致懷光變忠為逆，李納父子，宜其茍延。

translations.literal: the court employed Lu Qi, using private to obstruct public, causing Huai Guang to change loyalty to rebellion—Li Na father and son, fittingly they dragged on.
translations.idiomatic: The court employed Lu Qi, using private to obstruct public, causing Huai Guang to change loyalty to rebellion—Li Na father and son fittingly dragged on.

sentences.zh: 洎憲宗當朝，裴度為相，君臣道合，中外情通；

translations.literal: When Xianzong held court, Pei Du was chief minister; ruler and minister's Way joined, within and without sentiment connected;
translations.idiomatic: When Xianzong held court, Pei Du was chief minister. Ruler and minister's Way joined, within and without sentiment connected;

sentences.zh: 師道外任諸奴，內聽群婢，軍民攜貳，家族滅亡，不亦宜乎！

translations.literal: Shidao outwardly entrusted various slaves, inwardly listened to the crowd of maidservants; army and people carried divided hearts and the clan perished—is it not fitting!
translations.idiomatic: Shidao outwardly entrusted various slaves, inwardly listened to the crowd of maidservants. Army and people carried divided hearts and the clan perished—is it not fitting!

sentences.zh: 假息數年，猶為多矣，何所疑焉？

translations.literal: A few years' borrowed breath was already more than enough—what is there to doubt?
translations.idiomatic: A few years' reprieve was already more than they deserved—what is there to doubt?

sentences.zh: 贊曰：田神功勇能立勛，令狐彰死不失節。

translations.literal: The encomium says: Tian Shengong was brave and able to establish merit; Ling Huzhang did not lose his integrity even in death.
translations.idiomatic: The encomium says: Tian Shengong was brave and able to establish merit; Ling Huzhang did not lose his integrity even in death.

sentences.zh: 薛平振家世以顯揚，師道任臧獲則亡滅。

translations.literal: Xue Ping revived his family's standing through illustrious achievement; Shidao entrusted power to slaves and servants—and was destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: Xue Ping revived his family's standing through illustrious achievement; Shidao entrusted power to slaves and servants—and was destroyed.
